listings.description: Limited Edition. Eau de Parfum. . Ribbons lifting in warm summer air. Gilded horses turning, rising, falling. Candy floss pulled into clouds and kissed from sticky fingers.. Afternoon light caught on painted wood and amber bulbs, held just long enough to remember it by.. . Composition: . Pineapple Crème Glacée, Sugared Ribbons. Barbe à Papa, Coconut Crème Diplomate. Amber Carrousel Lights, Vanilla Crêpe. Perfumer: Odette Fontaine, 2026. . inci list: alcohol denat., parfum (fragrance), dipropylene glycol, 1,3-propanediol, cremophor rh 40, glucam p-20 .

listings.rawTitle: Gold Dust | 碎金香 Full Size 50ml | 1.7oz
listings.description: Eau de Parfum. 碎金 scattered gold. In Taiwanese, the word for peanut - 花生, huā shēng - sounds like "good things happening." Peanuts are scattered at weddings, placed on New Year tables and offered at temple altars, a symbol of blessing woven into everyday life.. Peanut candy, roasted peanuts wrapped in caramelised malt sugar, is among the most traditional of Taiwanese sweets, made for generations to mark celebrations and to share good fortune. The golden colour of the brittle and the warmth of the hands that made it are inseparable from the memory.. Perfumer Kaiwei Hsieh has captured that memory with tenderness and precision. Gold Dust opens with a roasted, nutty warmth that feels immediately familiar. Coffea Arabica adds a bittersweet depth, as though the candy was eaten alongside a strong cup of coffee. Sugarcane and malt sweeten the base with the sticky, caramelised comfort of something made by hand and given with love.. Gold Dust is the fragrance of a tiny piece that hides a heart that still holds space to wonder. Scattered gold, scattered blessings, still warm from someone's hands.. Composition: . Black Gold Roasted Peanut. Coffea Arabica. Sugarcane, Malt. Perfumer: Kaiwei Hsieh, 2025. inci list: Alcohol, Parfum, Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes, Acetyl Cedrene, Juniperus Virginiana Oil, Limonene, Pinene, Pogostemon Cablin Oil, Beta-Caryophyllene, Coumarin, Hexamethylindanopyran, Terpinolene, Eugenol, Alpha-Terpinene, Linalool, Terpineol, Isoeugenol, Farnesol, Camphor, Benzyl Benzoate, Geraniol, Citronellol, Geranyl Acetate, Vanillin .

listings.rawTitle: Island Crumb | 島國酥 Full Size 50ml | 1.7oz
listings.description: 島國 island nation. 酥 a crumbly pastry. Pineapple cake - 鳳梨酥, fenglisu - is Taiwan's most iconic souvenir, a buttery, crumbly shortcrust filled with sweet-tart pineapple jam. In Taiwanese Hokkien, the word for pineapple is "ong-lai," which sounds like a phrase meaning "prosperity arrives," making pineapple cakes the traditional gift for weddings, New Year celebrations and homecomings.. For a brand named after the act of bringing something home for the people who didn't travel, this fragrance could not be more fitting.. Perfumer Kaiwei Hsieh has captured the golden warmth of the pastry itself. Golden Diamond Pineapple, a prized Taiwanese cultivar, opens with bright, sun-drenched sweetness. Butter and sweet orange build the rich, crumbly warmth of the pastry crust, while vanilla settles the composition into something tender and familiar.. Island Crumb is the scent of a box being opened at a kitchen table. The gift unwrapped. Prosperity arrived.. Composition: . Sweet Orange. Golden Diamond Pineapple, Buttery Notes. Vanilla. Perfumer: Kaiwei Hsieh, 2025. inci list: Alcohol, Parfum, Hexamethylindanopyran, Coumarin, Cinnamyl Alcohol, Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil, Lemongrass Oil, Geranyl Acetate, Vanillin, Citral, Anethole, Benzaldehyde, Cinnamal, Limonene, Pinene, Geraniol, Terpineol .

listings.rawTitle: Distilled Heat | 烈釀 Full Size 50ml | 1.7oz
listings.description: Eau de Parfum. 烈 fierce. 釀 to brew. Kinmen kaoliang is Taiwan's most celebrated spirit, distilled from sorghum, an ancient cereal grain that General Hu Lien encouraged Kinmen's farmers to cultivate during the Chinese Civil War when importing alcohol from Taiwan proved too costly. The Kinmen distillery was built into underground tunnels originally dug to shelter from bombardment. What began as a military solution became a cultural institution, with kaoliang now consumed across Taiwan at a rate of over 45,000 litres a day.. Distilled Heat carries the fire of that spirit. Perfumer Kaiwei opens with the dry, grain-forward heat of sorghum, the first burn of kaoliang on the throat. Patchouli and vetiver ground the composition in the island's red earth and salt wind, while sandalwood draws it into a warm, woody resolution that lingers like the last pour of the evening.. A fragrance that is fierce but not restless. A toast to the unextinguishable fire in the heart.. Composition: . Sorghum (Kaoliang). Patchouli. Vetiver, Sandalwood. Perfumer: Kaiwei Hsieh, 2025. inci list: Alcohol, Parfum, Geraniol, Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil, Limonene, Terpineol, Acetyl Cedrene, Citronellol, Linalyl Acetate, Linalool, Pogostemon Cablin Oil/Pogostemon Cablin Leaf Oil, Juniperus Virginiana Oil, Hexyl Cinnamal, Isoeugenyl Acetate, Isoeugenol, Citral, Eugenol, Cinnamal, Eucalyptus Globulus Oil, Rose Ketones, Cedrus Atlantica Oil/Extract, Pinene, Benzyl Alcohol, Cinnamyl Alcohol, Terpinolene, Geranyl Acetate, Butylphenyl Methylpropional, Farnesol, Beta-Caryophyllene, Benzaldehyde, Amyl Cinnamal .

Eau de Parfum. . Bubble tea was invented in Taiwan in the 1980s and has since become one of the country's most recognisable cultural exports. But before it was a global phenomenon, it was something simpler: the cup after school, the comfort on the way to work, a tacit understanding between strangers in the same queue. In Taiwan, bubble tea is not a novelty. It is the taste of daily life.. Taimaru captures that everyday intimacy. Perfumer Kaiwei Hsieh opens the fragrance with the warm sweetness of Ruby Black Tea, Hongyu, one of Taiwan's most prized tea cultivars, grown in the mountains of Sun Moon Lake. Brown sugar and longan honey bring the rich, caramelised depth of boba syrup, while oolong tea grounds the composition with a roasted, subtly floral calm.. This is not a gourmand built for sweetness alone. It is a portrait of a ritual so embedded in everyday Taiwanese life that it almost goes unnoticed. Taimaru makes it visible again, in scent.. . Composition: . Ruby Black Tea (Hongyu). Brown Sugar, Longan Honey. Oolong Tea. Perfumer: Kaiwei Hsieh, 2025. . inci list: Alcohol, Parfum, Linalool, Limonene, Hexyl Cinnamal, Linalyl Acetate, Terpineol, Citrus Limon Peel Oil, Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes, Geraniol, Hexamethylindanopyran, Citrus Aurantium Bergamia Peel Oil, Pinene, Cedrus Atlantica Oil/Extract, Citral, Citronellol, Rose Ketones, Geranyl Acetate, Benzyl Benzoate, Terpinolene, Benzyl Alcohol, Alpha-Terpinene, Beta-Caryophyllene, Isoeugenol, Sclareol, Amyl Cinnamal, Cinnamyl Alcohol, Eugenol, Farnesol, Jasmine Oil/Extract, Alpha Isomethyl Ionone, Camphor, Anethole .

listings.rawTitle: Grounded Hills | 磨山川 Full Size 50ml | 1.7oz
listings.description: Eau de Parfum. . 磨 to grind. 山川 hills and rivers. Grounded Hills recalls the Hakka tradition of lei ch'a, or pounded tea, a ritual nearly two thousand years old in which tea leaves, grains and nuts are worked together in a stone mortar, turning the simplest ingredients into sustenance. In Taiwan, Hakka communities in Beipu, Hsinchu have kept this tradition alive for generations, the toasty, nutty scent of roasted grains filling the old street's air.. Perfumer Kaiwei Hsieh has translated this warmth into a fragrance of gentle, sustaining comfort. Sesame and brown rice open with a toasted, nutty richness. A roasted, earthy depth grounds the centre, while tea leaves carry the composition through with aromatic clarity.. Grounded Hills was a finalist in the Independent Category at the 12th Art and Olfaction Awards in Athens, 2026. A fragrance as sustaining as the tradition it recalls.. . Composition: . Sesame. Brown Rice, Toasted Grains. Tea Leaves. Perfumer: Kaiwei Hsieh, 2025. . inci list: Alcohol, Parfum, Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes, Linalool, Terpineol, Vanillin, Eugenia Caryophyllus Oil, Eugenol, Benzyl Alcohol, Limonene, Geraniol, Coumarin, Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil, Anethole, Beta-Caryophyllene, Cinnamal, Citrus Limon Peel Oil, Eugenyl Acetate, Rose Ketones, Pinene, Benzyl Salicylate, Benzyl Benzoate, Isoeugenol, Citral, Terpinolene, Benzyl Cinnamate, Alpha-Terpinene .

Extrait de Parfum. Limited Edition. . Devil's Delight is the evolution of Tobacco Sun, one of the earliest compositions in the Sentire x Sainte Cellier collection. Perfumer Nata Dyshliuk spent over a year developing a black cherry accord worthy of sitting alongside her beloved honey-glazed tobacco fragrance, and the result is something irresistibly warm and unapologetically indulgent.. The opening is boozy and bright: davana, with its top-shelf spirits character, crushed black cherry and sparkle of Ceylon cinnamon. The heart deepens into precious tobacco absolute and a signature dried fruit accord, stewed in golden honey. The base is pure amber luxury: mouthwatering Siam benzoin, caramel-rich and resinous, and the spiced vanillic warmth of Tolu balsam.. Nata's work is always evolving, and Devil's Delight is proof that the need to reformulate can lead to something generous and celebratory. The original architecture of tobacco and amber given a new facade of black cherry gloss, darker, bolder and devilishly delicious.. . Composition: . Cherry Nectar, Cinnamon, Davana. Dried Fruits, Tobacco Absolute, Honey. Siam Benzoin, Tolu Balsam, Amber. Perfumer: Nata Dyshliuk, 2026. Eau de Parfum. Teen is a memory you can smell. Another summer weekend spent patrolling your local mall with a $20 bill and unlimited possibility.. Perfumer Marissa Zappas has composed a fragrance that captures the unselfconscious joy of discovering scent for the first time: the fruity body spray trailing behind you on the way to math class, the sweet cloud of something cheap and glorious that made you feel invincible.. Blood orange and bergamot open bright and careless. Ripe passion fruit, rose, fresh cut grass and violet leaf build a heart that is simultaneously lush and innocent. Vanilla bean, tonka and cashmere musk close it out with the kind of warmth that feels like being young and not yet knowing that youth ends.. Composition: . Blood Orange, Bergamot. Ripe Passion Fruit, Rose, Fresh Cut Grass, Violet Leaf. Vanilla Bean, Tonka, Cashmere Musk. Perfumer: Marissa Zappas, 2025. inci list: Alcohol Denat., Fragrance (Parfum), Water (Aqua), Citral, Citronellol, Cyclopentadecanolide, Dimethylcyclohex-3-ene-1-Carbaldehyde (Mixed Isomers), Geraniol, Rose Ketones, Cis-3-Hexenyl Methyl Carbonate, P-Isopropylbenzyl Alcohol .

Eau de Parfum. Shiver is the scent of late winter tipping into spring. Snow melting over a small town parking lot. Crisp air hitting your face. The earth beginning to defrost.. Perfumer Marissa Zappas opens with eucalyptus, bergamot, ivy and white pepper, the sharp inhalation of cold air that catches in the chest. The heart is where Shiver becomes extraordinary: wet concrete, cold metal, vetiver and orris alongside a single startling pear note, luminous against all that grey.. The base settles into amber, cedarwood, oakmoss and patchouli, the ground warming slowly beneath your feet. This is a fragrance about the moment before everything changes, when the world is still frozen but no longer committed to winter.. Composition: . Eucalyptus, Bergamot, Ivy, White Pepper. Wet Concrete, Vetiver, Cold Metal, Orris, Pear. Pure Amber, Cedar Wood, Oak Moss, Musk, Patchouli. Perfumer: Marissa Zappas, 2025. inci list: Alcohol Denat., Fragrance (Parfum), Water (Aqua), Benzyl Salicylate, Cedrene, Citral, Isoeugenol, Lemon Oil Cold Pressed, Longifolene, Oakmoss/Treemoss, Alpha-Bisabolol, Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes .

Eau de Parfum. Calico is a Sunday morning that never has to end. Sun through bleached curtains, freshly washed sheets, a hot cup of tea and a kitten settling onto your pillow.. Perfumer Marissa Zappas has built this composition around one of perfumery's most tender accords: kitten fur, that warm, milky, slightly sweet scent of a sleeping animal. Toasted rice and bergamot open with quiet warmth. The heart unfolds into jasmine sambac, honeysuckle, warm milk, heliotrope and orange blossom, every note soft and unhurried.. Pillowy musk and clean vanilla close it with the gentleness of something you never want to leave. The morning silence interrupted only by purrs.. Composition: . Toasted Rice, Bergamot. Kitten Fur, Jasmine Sambac, Honeysuckle, Warm Milk, Heliotrope, Orange Blossom. Pillowy Musk, Clean Vanilla. Extrait de Parfum. Limited Edition. . Only in Dreams Collection . Label illustration by Johanna Kwiat. A fascinating, full-throated perfume that opens with a whiplash of lush, sweet decay and a quivering leather resembling iso-butyl quinoline, the decadent Dietrich heart of so many iconic 1930s and 40s fragrances like Vent Vert, Jolie Madame and Bandit, all composed by Germaine Cellier, whom Sainte Cellier was named after.. The heart of Stardust Narcissus swells with a narcotic bouquet of narcissus, jonquil, lily of the valley and jasmine, basking under an overdose of galbanum, a gum resin with bittergreen mastic, green apple and anisic facets.. Intriguing fact: bitter galbanum was used in sacred incense mixes to represent deliberate and unrepentant sinners.. Stardust Narcissus is a covetous perfume, playing off the nostalgic verdant echoes of vintage Guerlain and Caron with a sharp-edged sense of floral modernism, an opiate narcissus / jonquil duet dusted in moonlight, oakmoss and tendrils of incense.. As the name suggests, the notes in Stardust Narcissus shimmer and luminesce from that moody, leather-lash of startling galbanum and hyacinth through the heartswoon of flowers and smoke down to a stalwart base of woods, supple leather, rooty vetiver and oakmoss. It is however Brooke and Nata’s triumphant showcasing of a cosmic narcissus that will have you seeing stars.. . Composition: . Bergamot, Galbanum, Artemisia, Hyacinth. Narcissus Absolute, Jonquil Absolute, Orris Butter, Lily of the Valley, Jasmine. Oakmoss, Patchouli, Leather, Vetiver, Cedarwood. Perfumer: Nata Dyshliuk, 2025. . inci list: Hexamethylindanopyran, Pogostemon Cablin Oil, Alpha Isomethyl Ionone, Citrus Aurantium, Bergamia Peel Oil, Linalool, Limonene, Citral, Linalyl Acetate, Narcissus Extract, Evernia furfuracea (Treemoss) extract, Cyclamen Aldehyde, Geranyl Acetate, Hydroxycitronellal, Cananga Odorata Oil, Pinenes, Eugenol .

LIMITED EDITION PARFUM. . A Dream of Narcissus, Narcissus Dreams. However you interpret the name, the latest perfumed collaboration between Nata Dyshliuk of Sentire Perfumes and Brooke Belldon of Sainte Cellier is one of the very best thus far in a seductive and rewarding collection of scents that are resolutely seeped in tailored vintage perfumery and the modern wit and charm of Nata’s compositional skills.. Songe de Narcisse is gorgeously disturbing, dense and aptly narcotic, since the words share a common etymological origin in narké , a Greek word meaning numb, benumbed and torpor. This probably refers to the acknowledged toxicity of all parts of the flowers.. Songe is appropriately dreamy, but the dreams are rolled in forbidden sheets and carnal hunger. The classicism of a brutally tailored chypre is torn open by citric light, and the creation of a delightful fresh air accord that lifts the opening notes as a welcome Mediterranean breeze lifts fine linen off hot skin.. Ivy leaf is an unexpected addition, but one that instantly conjures up the cool, silvery clarity of distinctive climbing stalks and green triangular leaves. Most ivy notes in perfume lean toward fresh airiness, not so here. In Songe de Narcisse, it has a darker, colder vibe, not the polite hanging pots of ivy but the plant colonising crumbling walls and untended houses. The full visceral impact of the narcissus absolute with jasmine, lily of the valley and a subtle haze of iris.. The shock of the narcissus and its greedy pornography are sublime, so much perfumery is relatively anodyne these days. Yes there’s oud and musk with their phasers set to stun, nuclear roses and gourmands that can drown you in candyfloss and chocolate. But a high-quality narcissus absolute can still shock and awe, like a Joan Crawford slap in a green velvet glove.. It is about twenty minutes into wearing Songe De Narcisse that the dream haze of it aerates the profanity of the indolic floral with robust base notes of milky sandalwood, moss and patchouli drawing out the dazzling interplay above. Narcissus is a wondrous, illuminating and dirty note, a narcotic odour that divides and compels. This new addition to the Sentire x Sainte Cellier collection is a divine take on narcissus, proving once again Nata’s uncanny ability to redefine tropes and create magic.. . Composition . Sicilian Bergamot, Bitter Orange, Fresh Air Accord, Ivy Leaf. Narcissus Absolute, Jasmine, Lily of the Valley, Iris. Patchouli, Atlas Cedarwood, Oakmoss, Musk. Perfumer: Nata Dyshliuk, 2025. . inci list: Hexamethylindanopyran, Tetramethyl acetyloctahydronaphthalenes, Linalool, Benzyl Salicylate, Pogostemon Cablin Oil, Citrus Aurantium Bergamia Peel Oil, Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil, Cananga Odorata Extract, Hexyl Cinnamal, Amyl Salicylate, Narcissus Extract, Coumarin, Vanillin, Hydroxycitronellal, Cyclamen Aldehyde .

Extrait de Parfum. Limited Edition. . Only in Dreams Collection . Label illustration by Johanna Kwiat. . Gilded Labdanum is a hymn to the glory of chewy, sensual labdanum, a resin obtained from cistus, a species of rock rose. The top notes are a pungent trio of cumin, immortelle and honey, materials with the potential to obliterate all before them like a spiced resinous tsunami. Perfumer Nata Dyshliuk has been very circumspect in her use of these notes, using them to presage the seduction of the beautiful centre swelling underneath. Honey and beeswax are such a magnificent odour, one sweet and golden, suffused with pollen and the other a pheromonic imprint of old hives, bee wings and transmuted pollen.. It is the heart of Gilded Labdanum that really makes this perfume so aurous and luminescent, a beauteous melding of ylang ylang, Rose de Mai, that sublime beeswax and a subtle veil of incense. This is where a sense of gilding begins to truly apply. Gilding is a remarkable skill, the application of whisper-thin sheets of 18k gold leaf onto size-prepared wood and then buffed to create a high shine, it is symbolic of the sun and holy light, used for hagiographic halos and stars on vaults of heavenly blue.. Gilded Labdanum glows with an addictive pull as the perfume plunges into a base redolent with the fulcrum labdanum, resins, tactile balsams, woods and vanilla. The leathered, shrubby pungency of labdanum echoing the liquorice and garam masala tinted immortelle.. Brooke’s passion for vintage perfumes is traced gently through the heart of rose, ylang and beeswax. But the scented endgame of bold, erotic materials smeared and exalted by labdanum is impossible to resist, making it a perfect addition to the already impressive Sentire X Sainte Cellier collection.. . Composition: . Cumin, Immortelle, Honey. Ylang-ylang, Beeswax Absolute, Rose de Mai, Incense. Benzoin, Tolu Balsam, Atlantic Cedarwood, Mysore Sandalwood, Vanilla, Labdanum. Perfumer: Nata Dyshliuk, 2025. . inci list: Tetramethyl acetyloctahydronaphthalene, Hexamethylindanopyran, Cedrus Atlantica Oil, Santalum Album Oil, Cananga Odorata Oil, Pogostemon Cablin Oil, Vanillin, Geraniol, Citronellol, Citronellal, Citronellyl acetate, Rose Ketones, alpha-Hexyl cinnamic aldehyde, Eugenol, Benzaldehyde, Benzyl alcohol, Benzyl benzoate, Coumarin, Alpha Isomethyl Ionone, Citral, Cyclamen aldehyde, Linalool, Farnesol, Methyl eugenol, Methyl Salicylate .

Limited Edition. Extrait de Parfum. Bovarysme is a term that emerged in the cultural afterlife of Gustave Flaubert’s Madame Bovary and was developed into a philosophical concept by Jules de Gaultier at the end of the nineteenth century. In its most famous formulation, it names the human capacity to imagine oneself as other than one is: to experience the limits of one’s present life against the image of another.. In Emma, the capacity to imagine herself otherwise appears at once as illusion and propulsion. Her bovarysme is not merely a name for dissatisfaction with the life she has, but an attempt to exceed it. She is painfully susceptible to the promises carried by romance, luxury and social ascent, yet the hunger beneath them is not trivial. It is the hunger to become, to exceed the life she has been given.. To describe Emma Bovary as deluded isn’t exactly wrong, but it is incomplete. Her fantasies become increasingly extravagant and her attempts to realise them increasingly destructive, but the dissatisfaction from which they spring is not imaginary. Emma sees the narrowness of the life available to her with painful clarity. She wants another life. Yet the alternatives she imagines are themselves assembled from cultural fantasies: romantic novels, aristocratic glamour, luxury, erotic passion. She recognises the insufficiency of her life accurately, then repeatedly misrecognises what will cure it.. The tragedy isn't that she wants too much, but that she has learned to recognise freedom through representations. Her hunger is real. The objects onto which she projects it are less reliable. There is something almost heroic in the ferocity of that wanting. Emma Bovary has a rage to live.. Peer Parfum approaches Bovary not as a period character to be nostalgically reconstructed, but as a figure whose desires remain recognisable in the present. Created in collaboration with sculptor Gina Fischli and Clemens Hunziker and composed by Master Perfumer Antoine Lie, the perfume takes Emma’s hunger, self-invention and destructive longing as its starting point, creating an olfactory mirror for the hungry beast in us all.. Bovary is excessive, animalic and unstable, built around a blaze of tuberose, gardenia and orange blossom, with cardamom, incense, leather and vinyl moving underneath.. Among Bovary’s materials, the pairing of leather and vinyl feels especially revealing. Leather carries long associations with luxury and craftsmanship. Vinyl can reproduce its surface, its texture, even something of its olfactory character. Yet the interest lies not in a simple opposition between authentic and artificial. Placed side by side, they stage the slippage between material and representation, luxury and the sign of luxury, substance and surface.. In Emma, that distinction feels peculiarly acute. Emma’s tragedy is not a simple inability to distinguish the real from the false, but her faith in the signs through which a desired life announces itself.. Objects, lovers and social rituals become evidence of another existence, as though possessing its surfaces might make that existence her own.. Leather and vinyl make that logic tactile. The life Emma desires becomes legible to her through the objects that signify it, until the performance of a desired existence begins to stand in for the existence itself.. If leather and vinyl articulate the structures of Bovary’s desire, the white flowers give that desire a body. Tuberose, gardenia and orange blossom bloom indecently alive, with the force of something that refuses moderation.. That refusal feels true to Emma. Her wanting is rarely discreet. It swells and spills beyond whatever container is meant to hold it. In Bovary, the white flowers translate that ferocity into scent.. It is particularly apt, then, that Emma should be revisited through perfume. Smell already occupies an unusually potent place in Madame Bovary, repeatedly carrying her across the boundary between the life she inhabits and the lives she imagines.. The tobacco and verbena lingering in the Viscount’s cigar case become an olfactory fragment from which Emma reconstructs an entire inaccessible world. Later, the perfume of Rodolphe’s hair folds the present into memories of the Viscount, Léon and Vaubyessard, until sensation, recollection and fantasy begin to blur into one another.. For Flaubert, smell doesn’t merely remind Emma of what she’s lost. It gives sensory form to what she has never possessed. Perfume becomes one more means by which another existence can be made briefly palpable: close enough to enter, intoxicating enough to believe in, yet impossible to hold.. Peer Parfum’s Bovary inhabits that same unstable territory. It captures the thrill of imagining oneself otherwise alongside the danger of allowing the signs of a desired life to stand in for the life itself. Desire here is luminous and ferocious, with consequence already present inside the wanting.. This is not a perfume of aspiration. Bovary is a perfume about aspiration and the signs through which we have been taught to recognise the life we desire.. Composition: . Cardamom, Neroli. Orange Blossom, Tuberose, Gardenia. Leather, Vinyl, Incense. Perfumer: Antoine Lie, 2026.

Eau de Parfum. . Rendez-Vous! is one of the most fascinating and sensual perfumes in recent years, a collaboration between Master Perfumer and olfactive mischief maker Antoine Lie and French photographer Sonia Sieff, daughter of the legendary JeanLoup Sieff.. Perfumer Antoine Lie is one of the most charismatic figures in contemporary perfumery. His creations range from commercial successes like Armani Code, Romance for Men by Ralph Lauren and Crystal Noir by Versace, to the punk and avant-garde perfumes of Etat Libre d'Orange Sécrétions Magnifique and Comme des Garçons Wonderwood. What they all have in common is being unforgettable.. While there are subtle references to Lie's unique oeuvre, Rendez-Vous! smells neoteric and erotic. It is essentially a portrait of a metallic iris; rhizome, stigma, anthers, signals, falls and petals. The initial violent overture of powder and musks smells of shattered flowers and twisted metal. The beautiful flacon is a deep burgundy colour, but the perfume is one pale bruise blues and mauve, albeit tinted with the rust red of dried blood.. The most unusual note mentioned in Rendez-Vous! is gunpowder. There is often a mingling of olfactive imaginings, the smell of gunpowder and gun smoke, which are different, but we tend to think of them as one and the same, a bitter-fumed mix of steely black pepper, singed charcoal, sometimes a whiff of brimstone, white steam and an undertone of sour green.. In Rendez-Vous! Antoine has used its associations and effects to act like a hearth fire in a blood red room filled with peonies, poached rhubarb and the romantic skin-dust bloom of orris. The gunpowder is less of a note than a mood, something to push at our memory larder and then work its magic throughout the composition. Everyone will interpret it differently.. Rhubarb has been used to add a succulent blush and tartness to Rendez-Vous! There is juiciness and an odour profile that smells of acidic strawberry, sugared saffron and rainbows. It counterpoints the lingering sky traces of fireworks implied by the gunpowder.. Sonia and Antoine have created something ambiguous and daring. It is a thin line between thoughtful art and uncomfortable pretension. Rendez-Vous! is a hugely alluring and secretive perfume, smouldering with enigma and materials that rise and fall like piqued desire. It is difficult to think of anything else like it except perhaps buried in the DNA of Antoine’s work to date. He is asking us to rethink how materials, both natural and cyborg, function as veils of protection and intimate rapture. Sonia Sieff gives us beauty and yearning, an opportunity to gaze and consider the masculine form, while Antoine mirrors and augments the viewing with a perfect perfume that floods the senses with craven flame.. Composition: . Gunpowder, Rhubarb. Peony, Orris. Guaiac wood, Benzoin resinoid. Perfumer: Antoine Lie, 2024. . inci list: alcohol denat., fragrance (parfum), water (aqua), alpha-isomethyl ionone, coumarin, linalool, geraniol, citronellol, citral, benzyl benzoate .

Eau de Parfum. A creamy-white confection skewered straight through the heart and roasted over the embers of a sandalwood flame. Don’t let the graham crackers fool you, this isn’t a treat… it’s dinner.. Curling smoke from a freshly lit Capri drifts into musky clouds of orris, tonka, and ambrette, smudging the line between confection and carnal.. Composition: . Graham Cracker Dust. Toasted Marshmallow, Roasted Orris. Ambrette, Tonka, Sandalwood, Musk. Perfumer: Marissa Zappas, 2026.

listings.rawTitle: WILD NARCISSUS | 野水仙 Full Size 50ml | 1.7oz
listings.description: Eau de Parfum. . The narcissus absolute familiar to perfumery, which is dense, green and earthy bears little resemblance to the flower in bloom. The living scent of narcissus is something else entirely: the softness of white florals, a pronounced indolic warmth and a vivid, sappy greenness that fills a room. One is a material. The other is an atmosphere. With Wild Narcissus, Aromag set out to capture the atmosphere.. In the spring of 2025, Aromag brought a pot of Narcissus tazetta var. chinensis, grown over two months and in full bloom, into the Symrise laboratory in Shanghai. Using Headspace technology, the scent of the narcissus was recorded at the moment of flowering and reconstructed from that trace. This method traces the flower's presence in the air, creating a faithful snapshot of the atmosphere of the bloom.. Narcissus tazetta var. chinensis is believed to have reached China through maritime trade during the Tang-Song period (7th–13th century) and was subsequently cultivated in southern Fujian, where distinct local forms were established over centuries. In China, narcissus is known as 水仙 (shuǐxiān) , the water fairy, and Wild Narcissus carries the full name 野水仙 (yě shuǐxiān) , meaning wild water fairy. Traditionally cultivated in shallow dishes of water and pebbles to bloom in time for the New Year, it is bound to the turning of the year, to these quiet arrangements, and to a continuity of scent that has passed through generations.. With Wild Narcissus, perfumer Florent di Marino gently extended the feeling of early spring. Galbanum and celery seed bring a vegetal, freshly cut greenness close to the snap of a stem. A touch of frankincense introduces a quiet spice, giving dimension to the green. Jasmine and ylang-ylang round out the body of white florals. At the base, myrrh and patchouli lengthen the fragrance, adding depth without obscuring the flower itself.. From beginning to end, the composition remains centred on a single idea: a narcissus in bloom. For a long time, narcissus belonged to the water's edge. With Wild Narcissus, Aromag has joyfully brought it into air.. Composition: . Celery Seed*, Galbanum*. Narcissus (Headspace), Jasmine*, Ylang-Ylang*. Olibanum*, Myrrh*. The notes marked with an asterisk are derived from natural ingredients. . Perfumer: Florent di Marino, 2026.

Limited Edition . Eau de Parfum. Fraise de Nuit is a strawberry fragrance for people who would never wear a strawberry fragrance. It is night-ripe, cool-skinned, lit from underneath. Where most fruit-forward compositions reach for sweetness, perfumer Marypierre Julien reaches for the earth.. The strawberry here is a natural upcycled extract: not confected or candied but fleshy, bright, and disarmingly real. It rouges the vetiver, flushing warmth and fruit across something earthy and rooted. Beneath and around it, five distinct expressions of vetiver build a landscape of smoke, soil, green root and dry wood. Five ways of saying the same word, each one a different hour of the night. The upcycled rice vanilla that also appears in its companion fragrance A Sigh of Dawn provides the warm, creamy undertow, the thread of gold in the darkness.. The olfactive profile is listed as "Nocturnal Fruit," a category that barely exists until you smell this and realise it should. Fraise de Nuit is the fragrance equivalent of walking through a city after midnight: the air still warm, the streetlamps catching something you can't quite name, the world briefly turning gold as you pass through it.. small stars flicker beneath your steps . a brief, hidden spark in the night . the city turns gold as you pass . then slips back into dark . Illustrations: Daniele Catalli. Poems: Paula Cañón. 93% Natural Composition: . Natural Strawberry (upcycled). Five Vetiver Expressions. Vanilla ex Rice (upcycled). Perfumer: Marypierre Julien, 2026. inci list: Alcohol Denat., Parfum (Fragrance), Aqua (Water), Acetyl Cedrene, Alpha-terpinene, Benzyl Alcohol, Benzyl Benzoate, Benzyl Salicylate, Beta Caryophyllene, Camphor, Cananga Odorata Oil/Extract (Ylang Ylang Oil), Citral, Citrus Aurantium Bergamia Peel Oil, Farnesol, Geranyl Acetate, Hexyl Cinnamal, Isoeugenol, Limonene, Linalool, Linalyl Acetate, Pinene, Terpineol, Terpinolene, Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes, Trimethyl-cyclopentenyl Methylisopentenol, Vanillin. .

listings.description: Limited Edition . Eau de Parfum. A Sigh of Dawn is the sound the world makes before it fully wakes. Frassaï's thirteenth creation captures a threshold most perfumery ignores: not the bright arrival of morning but the liminal exhalation just before it, when the air is still holding the night's warmth and the first light wakes humid and tentative, but already irreversible.. Perfumer Marypierre Julien, a Senior Perfumer at Givaudan who trained under both Jean-Louis Sieuzac and Bertrand Duchaufour, has built the composition around a tension between green transparency and woody depth.. Green mandarine opens with a sparkling, tart citrus brightness that gives way to the true heart of the composition: fig leaves. Luminous and vivid, with the milky, lactonic softness that fig fragrances are loved for, they carry the humid breath of a garden before the dew has burned off. Beneath this, an upcycled rice vanilla provides a quiet, creamy warmth that holds the green notes from below. Atlas cedarwood grounds the composition with a spiced, balsamic sweetness, its caramel depth accentuating the fig's lushness, creating a fragrance that's alive and generous.. A Sigh of Dawn is a fragrance that feels genuinely transitional: caught between dark and light, between coolness and warmth, between the last exhalation of sleep and the first conscious breath.. the door is a reflection of light . a certain shade of green — humid, shy . not there yet, but . from afar, there is no way back . Illustrations: Daniele Catalli. Poems: Paula Cañón. 93% Natural Composition: . Vert de Mandarine. Fig Leaves. Vanilla ex Rice (upcycled), Cedarwood Atlas. Perfumer: Marypierre Julien, 2026. inci list: Alcohol Denat., Parfum (Fragrance), Aqua (Water), Alpha-terpinene, Benzyl Benzoate, Beta-caryophyllene, Camphor, Cedrus Atlantica Oil Extract, Citral, Citrus Aurantium Bergamia Peel Oil, Citrus Aurantium Flower Oil, Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil, Coumarin, Farnesol, Geraniol, Geranyl Acetate, Hexyl Cinnamal, Hydroxycitronellal, Lavandula Oil Extract, Limonene, Linalool, Linalyl Acetate, Pinene, Rose Ketones, Terpineol, Terpinolene, Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes, Vanillin. .

Eau de Parfum. Café Arabesque is the first release from any haute parfumerie house to work with specialty coffee terroirs, using single origin fruit grown by the APAS cooperative (Associação dos Produtores do Alto da Serra) in the mountains of São Gonçalo do Sapucaí, Minas Gerais, Brazil. APAS was founded in 2006 as a collective of smallholder farmers determined to protect what industrial coffee production had erased: origin, traceability, and fair compensation for producers. They were Fairtrade pioneers in Brazil and remain part of the fewer than 2% of global coffee production classified as specialty grade.. Perfumer Antoine Lie collaborated with Julien Galéa, founder of Swiss specialty roasters Kojo, to begin a long selection process across different origins and varieties, searching for a precise, elegant aromatic profile that Julien would describe in the cup as a "Grand Classique." Antoine's preference landed on the APAS farms: Mondo Novo and Catuai varieties with a character of dark chocolate, roasted hazelnut, yellow fruits and fresh florals. Julien and his team then proposed several roasting profiles, each revealing a different facet of this exceptional bean. The roasted coffee then underwent weeks of ultrasound extraction in the Les Indémodables R&D laboratory, a painstaking process to draw out the complete aromatic depth, creating a Grand Cru labelled coffee extract used at 6% concentration in Café Arabesque.. The opening is a bold ristretto rendered in scent: woody, aromatic, bright with a snap of liquorice. Café Arabesque then unfolds laterally into a creamy mochaccino accord, softening with cocoa powder and lightly roasted hazelnut. Benzoin "large tears" resinoid from Laos and New Caledonian Sandalwood Album oil build a warm, resinous, deeply sensual drydown that refuses to let go.. Café Arabesque returns coffee to its luxury origins. A fruit of extraordinary complexity, shaped by its terroir, roasted with intention, extracted with patience, and rendered in perfume with the reverence it has always deserved.. Composition: . 6% Brazilian Speciality Coffee Ultrasound Extract. 1.1% New Caledonian Sandalwood 'Album' Oil. 0.8% Laotian Benzoin 'Large Tears' Resinoid. Perfumer: Antoine Lie, 2026. inci list: Alcohol Denat, Parfum (Fragrance), Aqua (Water), Tetramethylacetyloctahydronaphthalenes, Vanillin, Ebanol, Geranyl Acetate, Citral, Citronellol, Geraniol, Citrus Aurantium Bergamia Peel Oil, Pogostemon Cablin Oil, Alpha Terpinene, Anethol, Benzaldehyde, Benzyl Benzoate, Beta-caryophyllene, Coumarin, Limonene, Linalool, Linalyl Acetate, Menthol, Evernia Prunastri Extract, Pinene, Santalum Album Oil, Santalol, Terpineol, Terpinolene, Bht, Ethylhexyl Salicylate, Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane (Avobenzone) .

Limited Edition Eau de Parfum. . Fée du Lilas is available by advance reservation only, with pre-orders closing on 30 June. Please reserve your bottle before then, as this limited edition will not be available for general sale. . Fée du Lilas is an especially personal work for perfumer Odette Fontaine.. The fragrance was created in memory of her sister, who was murdered in 2024. 30th June, the day of the fragrance's official release, would have been her birthday. Lilac was her favourite flower, and as a ballet dancer she loved performing the role of the Lilac Fairy in Sleeping Beauty. To Odette, she will always be her lilac fairy.. Rather than a photorealistic lilac perfume, Fée du Lilas is a gossamer-soft memory of lilacs blooming in their grandmother's garden. Delicate petals drift through notes of sugared mirabelle plum, meringue kisses, vanilla and sweet olibanum, creating a parfum that feels luminous, comforting and quietly nostalgic.. A portion of proceeds from every bottle sold will be donated to Brady United and their work to prevent gun violence.. . Composition: . Mirabelle Sugar, Lilac Petals. Baisers de Meringue, Tiaré Flower Milk. Vanilla, Blonde Cedar, Sweet Olibanum. Perfumer: Odette Fontaine, 2026.

Eau de Parfum. Pre-orders open until 30th June. All orders ship in July, once stock arrives from the States. . Kentucky tobacco was once the state's defining crop. From the 1930s through the late twentieth century, most farms grew some, and the cultivation cycle, from spring planting through summer topping and autumn curing in those tall, slatted barns with the leaves hanging in tiers, structured an entire agricultural calendar.. The federal tobacco program supported prices and managed how much each farm could grow from 1938 until 2004, when Congress passed the Fair and Equitable Tobacco Reform Act and ended the system. By then, foreign competition, falling domestic demand and a properly belated public reckoning with the tobacco industry made the program unsustainable. The buyout was the exit ramp from a structure that had supported farmers for nearly seventy years.. Twenty years on, fewer than a thousand Kentucky farms still grow tobacco. Some counties that once had hundreds of growers have seven or eight. The barns are still there, mostly, weathering into the landscape.. Dawn Spencer Hurwitz's composition is a sepia-toned photograph of that vanishing world, capturing the agricultural smell of leaves curing in summer heat: honeyed, haylike, leather-and-molasses warm. Dark plum opens against dry cedar, the architectural smell of an empty curing barn. Drying tobacco leaves bring honey and hay through the heart, then deepen into cured leather and molasses, with the faint smokiness of aging wood. A velvety rose threads through, softening the rustic edges. Amber and sandalwood settle the base into a warm, textured glow.. Composition: . Plum, Rose. Drying Tobacco, Barn Wood. Leather, Molasses, Honey. Perfumer: Dawn Spencer Hurwitz, 2025.

Eau de Parfum. Pre-orders open until 30th June. All orders ship in July, once stock arrives from the States. . The Inner Bluegrass region of central Kentucky sits on Lexington Limestone, deposited four hundred and fifty million years ago when the land was a shallow tropical sea. The limestone is rich in calcium and phosphate. Acidic water has been dissolving it ever since, releasing minerals into the soil that feed the grass that gives the region its name.. Poa pratensis, Kentucky bluegrass, with its slight blue cast at the seed heads, only thrives there because of what the ancient sea left behind. The horses that run the Kentucky Derby have strong bones because of the calcium in the grass. The bourbon Kentucky is famous for is sweetened by the iron filtered out of the limestone water. The whole identity of the state comes out of the floor of a vanished ocean.. Dawn Spencer Hurwitz's composition holds that landscape in skin temperature. Wet grass and violet leaf open with the dew of pasture before sunrise. Lavender drifts in like a herbaceous breeze. Orris adds a powdery elegance, then settles into the damp mineral pull of oakmoss and the hay-tinged earthy warmth of vetiver.. Bluegrass is also the name of a genre of music few other countries could produce. Bill Monroe, from Rosine, Kentucky, named his band the Blue Grass Boys in the late 1930s after his home state, and the genre took its name from his band. What Monroe invented was a fusion of Appalachian folk traditions inherited from Irish, Scottish and English settlers, African American blues and gospel (he specifically credited the Black miner and fiddler Arnold Schultz as a formative influence) and the high lonesome vocal sound of mountain singing. Like the grass, the music could only have come from there. Specifically American, specifically Kentucky, specifically the product of soil and history and inheritance refined into something that didn't exist before.. Composition: . Wet Grass, Violet Leaf. Lavender, Orris. Oakmoss, Hay, Vetiver. Perfumer: Dawn Spencer Hurwitz, 2025.

Eau de Parfum. Pre-orders open until 30th June. All orders ship in July, once stock arrives from the States. . The Kentucky Derby, first Saturday in May, in the bluegrass country, the same ritual returned to since 1875. People travel for it, save for the hats, look forward to it for months. The hours leading up to the race are themselves the event: 150,000 people dressed beautifully, drinking mint juleps in silver cups, holding small hopes about horses. My Old Kentucky Home will be sung, the rose blanket will be brought out, and for two minutes everyone in the world goes quiet and watches. The waiting is hopeful waiting. The whole day is held in optimism.. Dawn Spencer Hurwitz's composition catches that suspended hope on skin. Clementine and bergamot open like the cool gust that arrives just when the heat is rising. Neroli and jasmine settle in for the afternoon. Ambergris and musk hold quietly through the hours, soft enough to belong to the wearer alone, present enough to last until evening. The fragrance has the structural shape of Derby Day itself: not the two minutes of spectacle, but the long, hopeful, beautifully dressed hours that surround them.. Derby belongs to a particular American luxury register: clean, pulled-together, chic while still being approachable. American elegance can hold legibility well, because at its best it was built around motion.. In 1972, Estée Lauder commissioned Francis Camail and Bernard Chant to create Aliage, the world's first sports fragrance, conceived for what Mrs. Lauder called the contemporary woman who moves around the world as if it were her home. In the 1990s, Ralph Lauren's Polo Sport spawned an entire category of athletic-adjacent scent. While Calvin Klein's CK One in 1994 took the lineage further still, creating the first gender-fluid mainstream perfume, a citrus-musk skin scent that taught American luxury what effortlessly shared could smell like.. Derby is that fifty-year lineage refined: the aesthetics of American optimism reflected in the familiar, inclusive and hopefully, always moving forward.. Composition: . Clementine, Bergamot. Neroli, Jasmine. Ambergris, Musk. Perfumer: Dawn Spencer Hurwitz, 2025.

Eau de Parfum. . Pre-orders open until 30th June. All orders ship in July, once stock arrives from the States. . Spacewood is pure sensate molecular immersion, a synthetic love letter to skin. It has the remarkable properties of feeling and smelling seamless, a floating astral infusion of stardust and cool flesh.. It is difficult to create a scent that has no sense of porosity, you would imagine that elements break away and compose themselves into fragments and reflections. There is a superb example, Alaïa by Alaïa, made by the talented Marie Salamagne. Alaïa wanted a perfume that resembled the smooth brick walls of his homeland, baking in the North African heat. If water were thrown, it would just evaporate off. Alaïa in discussions with Marie, wanted only smoothness, the mix of materials to be cunning and absolute. At no point did he want anything to smell over, out and under his brief.. This concept is at play in Spacewood, with Christophe Laudamiel and Christian Hornetz presenting an opaque wall of scent that slowly dissolves over time on our skin, allowing just a glimpse of the futuristic soft machinery within the composition. They show us a combination of spider web strength and gossamer tension with hints of cybersex and robotic desire.. A selection of synthetic molecules is poured over a framework of Egyptian jasmine, acacia flowers and dry white wine. All shades of mellow yellow fixed in time. Spacewood floats just above the skin, never quite achieving traditional osmosis but still allowing us to experience a perfume that both comforts and confounds. It's a strangely beautiful scent of invisibility and transformation.. . Composition: . White Wine, Ozone, Anise. Egyptian Mimosa, Acacia Flower. Luminous Woods. Perfumers: Christophe Laudamiel and Christophe Hornetz, 2016. . inci list: Alcohol Denat., Fragrance, Water / Aqua, Hexyl Cinnamal, Eugenol, Benzyl Benzoate, Amyl Cinnamal, Citral, Citronellal, Geraniol, Benzyl Alcohol .

Eau de Parfum. Pre-orders open until 30th June. All orders ship in July, once stock arrives from the States. . Rhubarb is one of those plants that reminds us we can still sometimes smell with our eyes. Stalky bitter greens, the apple-like blush of scarlet fruit flesh and the acerbic rub of leaves, tainted by the poison of oxalic acid.. It is generally perceived as a sweet fruit, stewed or poached with brown sugar and shards of fresh ginger. Rhubarb crumble, unctuous syllabub and the joy of rhubarb pie served with pouring cream. It can be a beautiful tart note as well, cutting through the oiliness of mackerel.. Despite its potential, there have only been a handful of stand out rhubarb perfumes. The salty, rubiaceous glow of Eau de Rhubarbe Ecarlate from Hermes, the foraged urban oasis of Lost in the City for Miller Harris, and Sherbet Rhubarb for Commes de Garçons, both by Bertrand Duchaufour. All these delicious exemplars showcase different facets of this mouth-watering note.. With Rhubarb My Love, Christophe has tilted succulent limey tartness with rhubarb’s ruby throats. Initially it smells incredibly photorealistic with a dewy shock of sap and pink rhubarb, but as it expands it becomes more abstract, more Rothko than Richter.. Sparkling citrus notes and a hint of mulch cut through any potential overt sweetness. As it dries down, it reveals a delicate pink champagne vibe, a touch of yeasty fizz and chilled freshness. The journey from full on rhubarb to this woody aromatic base is lovely, demonstrating once again Christophe Laudamiel's ability to shift expected perceptions.. Composition: . Tomato Leaf. Rhubarb. Vetiver. Perfumer: Christophe Laudamiel, 2016. inci list: Alcohol Denat., Fragrance, Water / Aqua, Butylphenyl MethylProprional, Cinnamal, Eugenol, Limonene, Amyl Cinnamal, Linalool, Benzyl Benzoate, Cinnamyl Alcohol, Citral, Geraniol, AmylCinnamyl Alcohol, Benzyl Alcohol, Farnesol .

Eau de Parfum. Pre-orders open until 30th June. All orders ship in July, once stock arrives from the States. . Christophe Laudamiel’s take on fig is dramatic, a full blown multi-sensory mix of realism and abstraction. It is a scent of a quiet villa on a Greek island, a private place, far from tourists and the distractions of modern life. No phones ring, music is muted and kind. Doors and windows open into a courtyard of fig trees, moving gently in a late summer breeze. The air is ripe with the oozing aroma of fruits, wasps lick at the milky tears of fallen figs. An orange tree in one corner exudes its juicy sharpness, creating a miasma of redolent fruitiness.. One of the benchmarks for fig perfumes must be Philosykos for Diptyque by the supremely talented Olivia Giacobetti. It was so ubiquitous at one point; you smelled it everywhere. Another would be Premier Figuier, also made by Giacobetti for L’Artisan Parfumeur, a very different take on fig. Up until the Diptyque perfume, fig was a relatively unknown in olfaction, it had been used but not as the leading performer.. Christophe’s fig is luscious and jungly, the aftermath of a storm has bruised the fruit. The greenness of Fig my Love is startling, hyper-grass and new shoots, apple-coloured ink bleeding into wet paper. Hints of coconut milk and powdered woods suggest the white ooze of slashed harvest. Like Rhubarb my Love, the realism of the fruit is illuminated by tropical vibes in that quiet villa courtyard garden. A man sits under the aromatic trees, shadows dappling his face, an old paperback fallen to the ground. He realises he is alone. He smiles.. Composition: . Fig Leaf, Fig Flesh. Fig Tree. Milky Sap. Perfumer: Christophe Laudamiel, 2016. inci list: Alcohol Denat., Fragrance, Water / Aqua, Linalool, Hexyl Cinnamal, Coumarin, Benzyl Benzoate, Citronellol, Geraniol, Anise Alcohol, Amyl Cinnamal, Limonene, Benzyl Alcohol, Citral, Eugenol .

Extrait de Parfum. Cheeky, nostalgic, soft-pawed and sweet.. Minou means “kitten” in French, and færal parfum leans fully into the fantasy: the pampered little creature, sun-warmed and adored, living a life of leisure somewhere between teenage daydream and decadent picnic.. Grapefruit, strawberry bubblegum and rhubarb open with a bright, tart snap before the fragrance softens into milky fig, fig leaf, warm grass and chalky iris. The drydown settles into vanilla marshmallow musk: fluffy, sweet and gently addictive without losing its playful bite.. Minou is a perfume of carefree nostalgia, but not innocence exactly. It has a flirtatious little glimmer beneath the softness: a kitten stretching in the sun, pretending not to know exactly how charming she is.. Composition: . Grapefruit, Strawberry Bubblegum, Rhubarb. Milky Fig, Fig Leaf, Warm Grass, Chalky Iris. Vanilla Marshmallow Musk. Perfumer: Britton Daley, 2026.

Extrait de Parfum. St. Clair Scents perfumes are available to pre-order until Sunday 29 June. Orders will be fulfilled once stock arrives. . Originally created in 2020 in collaboration with multi-sensory artist Erika Senft Miller, Seeking Balance returns as a limited edition from St. Clair Scents.. The perfume was first composed in the wake of the COVID pandemic: a moment when the world felt unsteady, suspended and profoundly out of balance. Diane St. Clair built the fragrance around materials with a natural feeling of calm and centre, including lavender, rose, jasmine and vetiver.. Retired in 2023 to make room in the St. Clair Scents collection, Seeking Balance has now been revisited for another turbulent time. This limited edition retains the beloved character of the original, but has been reformulated with Indian sandalwood: a beautiful, grounding material that deepens the composition and gives it a warmer, more meditative base.. Seeking Balance is a fragrance of restoration rather than escape. Aromatic lavender brings clarity, rose and jasmine open into quiet radiance, while vetiver and sandalwood draw the perfume back to earth. Soft, composed and deeply reassuring, it feels like a breath taken slowly: a return to stillness when the world outside has lost its centre.. Composition: . Bergamot, Mandarin Green, Lemon, Galbanum CO2. Lavender absolute and maillette, Rose Bulgaria, Geranium, Jasmin, Cassie Abs, Orris Butter. Patchouli, Oakmoss, Labdanum, Vetiver, Vanilla, Carrot Seed, Sandalwood India, Tonka Bean, Musks. Perfumer: Diane St. Claire, 2020. inci list: Alcohol denat., Fragrance, Benzyl benzoate, Benzyl salicylate, Citral, Citronellol, Coumarin, Eugenol, Farnesol, Geraniol, Hexyl cinnamal, Hydroxy-citronellol, Isoeugenol, Limonene, Linalool, Oakmoss and Treemoss Extract .

Extrait de Parfum. Pre-order offer: 10% off Neith until Sunday 21 June. All pre-orders include complimentary samples of Mohur Extrait and Eshal Extrait. Orders will ship once stock arrives. . “I am all that has been, that is, and that will be. No mortal has yet been able to lift the veil that covers me.” . Attributed to the Temple of Neith at Sais, after Plutarch . Neith is one of the oldest deities in the Egyptian pantheon: a primordial creator who emerged from the waters of chaos before the world had shape or lineage. She owed nothing to anyone. She created by weaving, drawing existence into being on her divine loom and reweaving it each day in an act of continuous creation.. She was the mother of Ra, the sun god. She also created Apep, the serpent of chaos. Light and darkness both came from her.. Neith held contradiction without apology. Mistress of the Bow, Great Weaver, mother, judge, mediator, protector of the dead. She carried weapons in one hand and thread in the other. She was associated with spiders, fate and the intricate labour of preserving what mattered beyond death.. Composed by Bertrand Duchaufour for Neela Vermeire Créations, Neith feels less like an illustration of myth than an act of weaving in itself: a tapestry of smoke, resin, spice, wood, shadow and light drawn between two remarkable creative minds.. Perfumery is always a woven art. Materials cross and catch. One note tightens another. Incense becomes structure, spice becomes heat, woods become shadow, flowers become colour blooming in the dark. Here, Neela Vermeire’s vision and Bertrand Duchaufour’s composition meet like warp and weft, building something ancient-feeling, intricate and pulsing with life.. Black pepper ignites the opening before the fragrance descends into a deep, myrrh-laced incense drydown. Frankincense, oud, opoponax, cypriol, vetiver, cedarwood, labdanum and castoreum give Neith its ritual density, while rose and carnation move through the centre, flickers of colour within the smoke. Ambergris, vanilla and sandalwood bring a slow, resinous warmth to the base.. Deep, rich, spicy and heavily threaded with myrrh, Neith feels like incense rising from the edge of creation: radiant from darkness, rooted in shadow and impossible to fully unveil.. Composition: . Black Pepper, Frankincense. Myrrh, Opoponax, Rose, Carnation. Oud, Cypriol, Vetiver, Cedarwood, Labdanum, Castoreum, Ambergris, Vanilla, Sandalwood. Perfumer: Bertrand Duchaufour, 2026.

Eau de Parfum. Creamy, fruity, pink. Pure sugar-rush joy.. Fleurt doesn't do subtle, and thank goodness. Peach, pink grapefruit and pink pepper open bright and juicy, tumbling into a heart of strawberries, cut wildflowers and candyfloss. Then the base turns almost edible: condensed milk, vanilla, almond gelato and amber, a soft-serve swirl that lingers like dessert. No deep meaning, no drama. Just a scent that makes you grin.. Composition: . Peach, Pink Grapefruit, Pink Peppercorn. Fresh Cut Wildflowers, Strawberries, Cotton Candy. Condensed Milk, Vanilla, Almond Gelato, Amber. Perfumer: Chad Hodge, 2024. inci list: Alcohol Denat., Parfum (Fragrance), Benzyl Benzoate, BHT .

Eau de Parfum. Dewy, green, alive. The smell of growing things.. Water Me opens cool and wet: moss, limestone, a leaf still beaded with dew. At its heart something stirs, an ozonic freshness, an oxidised petal, the green snap of cyclamen root, like the air just after rain in a glasshouse. It settles into soft amber and cedar, warm earth beneath all that green. Quietly radiant, elegant in its lightness, the scent of a wet stone warming in the sun.. Composition: . Moss, Limestone, Dewed Leaf. Ozone, Oxidised Petal, Cyclamen Root. Amber, Cedarwood, Oak, Earth. Perfumer: Chad Hodge, 2023. inci list: Alcohol Denat., Parfum (Fragrance), Geraniol, Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone, Eugenol, BHT .

Eau de Parfum. A carnal bloom. Rose worn raw.. Rouse opens with rose otto and a crack of leather, the flower and the whip set against each other from the first moment. Jasmine and honeyed hay warm the middle, all skin and sweetness, before it dries down into vetiver, oud and benzoin resin, earthy and animal and softly balsamic. Seductive but unhurried, a rose with its wild side showing.. Composition: . Rose Otto, Leather Whip. Jasmine Grandiflorum, Honeyed Hay. Vetiver, Oud, Benzoin Resin. Perfumer: Diandra Barsalou. inci list: Alcohol Denat., Parfum (Fragrance), Geraniol, Citronellol, Eugenol, Benzyl Benzoate, D-Limonene, Linalool, Benzyl Alcohol, Cinnamic Alcohol, Farnesol, Iso-Eugenol, Lyral, Citral, Coumarin, BHT .

Eau de Parfum. . Devil's trumpet - datura - blooms only after dark, unfurling its long pale flowers to release a scent that draws night-flying moths in to pollinate it. Beautiful, narcotic and poisonous in every part.. Little wonder it gathered such a reputation. Datura runs all through the history of witchcraft and poison lore: an ingredient in flying ointments, a plant of trances, visions and altered states, handled by those who knew its dangers and used it anyway.. Bad Lily is built around that flower. Alpine violet, galbanum and nettle open sharp and green; the datura heart blooms wicked and luminous alongside lily of the valley and poisonberry; settling into tree moss, damson plum, patchouli and musk. A night-blooming thief. Wild, verdant, and not entirely to be trusted.. . Composition: . Alpine Violet, Galbanum, Nettle. Devil's Trumpet, Lily of the Valley, Poisonberry. Tree Moss, Damson Plum, Patchouli, Musk. Perfumer: Michael Nordstrand, 2024. inci list: Alcohol Denat., Parfum (Fragrance), Linalool, Hexyl Cinnamic Aldehyde, Eugenol, Geraniol, Citronellol, Oakmoss Extract, Benzyl Salicylate, D-Limonene, Benzyl Benzoate, Farnesol, Benzyl Alcohol, Iso-Eugenol .

Extrait de Parfum. . The Caribbean, and Cousteau has just surfaced. Wetsuit still on, salt drying on his skin, the first pull of pipe smoke against the taste of the sea. The depths are still in his eyes. This is the pause before the next dive.. Rubini's long-standing collaborator, perfumer Cristiano Canali, builds that whole cinematic moment: Caribbean fruit and salt-skin up top, long pepper and a curl of rum, then tobacco absolute and nautical woods pulling down into marine depths. Briny, warm, contemplative. Salt and smoke and sun on a body that's just been somewhere far below.. Every Rubini fragrance is composed around unique accords developed between Andrea Bissoli Rubini and Canali just for that perfume. In L'Eau Très Mer, those signatures run top to base: a salty skin accord in the opening, a diving suit accord at the heart (latex lovers, this one's for you) and nautical woods and marine depths anchoring the drydown. None of them exist anywhere else. They were built for this bottle.. L'Eau Très Mer is a fragrance for the stillness between adventures: another chapter in Rubini's decade-long olfactory dialogue.. Composition: . Caribbean Fruits, Salty Skin. Long Pepper Jungle Essence, Diving Suit, Rum CO2 Extract. Tobacco Absolute, Nautical Woods, Marine Depths. Perfumer: Cristiano Canali, 2026.

Eau de Parfum. Conceived as a luminous counterpart to the shadowy Ensang Noir, White Blood renders floral musk in perpetual motion: petals dissolving into sap, softness into radiance, floralcy into something vividly alive.. Despite what its notes might lead you to beleive, this is not a conventional white floral. Bertrand Duchaufour renders the genre as something sleek, mesmeric and opalescent, constantly shifting shape and tone on the skin. Black pepper and bergamot create a piquant rush before the joyful lift of starfruit swells vertiginously, bursting through the composition like a glittering disco ball, illuminating tiaré and pink lotus in flashes of iridescent light.. Then comes the transformation that increasingly feels like a signature of the L’Entropiste collection: the perfume does not settle into a fixed drydown so much as enter suspension. Musks and grey amber create a soft-focus, levitating canvas through which tiaré and pink lotus continue to flicker unexpectedly, giving the composition an nebulous, opaline bioluminescence.. With White Blood, Bertrand Duchaufour has created a fragrance in constant metamorphosis: opalescent and fluid, yet suspended in refracted radiance.. Composition: . Black Pepper, Bergamot. Starfruit, Tiaré, Pink Lotus. Vetiver, Musk, Gray Amber. inci list:Alcohol denat. (SD alcohol 40-B), Parfum (Fragrance), Limonene, Aqua (Water/Eau), Tetramethyl acetyloctahydronaphthalenes, Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil, Geraniol, Linalool, Citronellol, Pinene, Citrus Limon Peel Oil, Citrus Aurantium Bergamia Peel Oil, Beta-Caryophyllene, Farnesol, Linalyl Acetate, Rose Flower Oil/Extract, Citral, Terpinolene, Terpineol, Benzyl alcohol, Rose Ketones, Geranyl Acetate, Alpha-terpinene, Isoeugenol, Carvone, Eugenol .
