listings.rawTitle: MAGNOLIA DE BLEU | 青水木兰 Full Size 50ml | 1.7oz
listings.description:
Eau de Parfum. Carlos Benaim is a respected and very gifted perfumer; the trio of perfumes - Dawn, Music for a While and Eau de Magnolia - that he composed for Editions de Parfums Frédéric Malle are sensual and exquisitely assembled. He understands the demands and nuances of working with floral materials and Magnolia de Bleu for Aromag is exceptional and eccentric, a shifting portrait of a memory flower that smells like souvenirs of love.. The heart of the perfume is a white Champaca called Michelia x Alba (from Laboratoires Monique Rémy), grown in Guangxi in China. It has a gorgeous ivory cream floral personality with delicate green edges and hints of underripe fruit. It is intensely fragrant and Indonesian wedding garlands are traditionally a mingle of white Champaca and jasmine. The flowers are used to make Yulang tea, the tea leaves dried between layers of magnolia flowers.. Simultaneously a portrait of magnolia in full bloom, but also an exercise in the sensual diffusion of a particular alabaster radiance. Sometimes that radiance seems almost washed with pale blue, such is the intensity of this skyful of blooms.. There is a delicious poignancy in the interplay between the floral heart and the bright blush of citrus and rhubarb in the opening notes. Rhubarb is a unique scent, mixing green astringency with rubicund juiciness. The red and green pairing gently but effectively prevents any potential cloying of the magnolia and jasmine. Ultimately it is Carlos Benaim's swell of dreamy magnolia that will have you returning over and over to your skin, a beautiful thing, both photorealistic and the stuff of aphrodisiac dreams.. Composition: . Citrus, Rhubarb. Orange Blossom*, Michelia Alba LMR*, Jasmine*, White Magnolia HeadSpace. Vetiver*. Ingredients marked with an * are natural materials. LMR refers to a line of high-quality, sustainably sourced natural ingredients developed exclusively by IFF.
For an ingredient to qualify as LMR, every stage—from plant cultivation and harvesting to extraction—must adhere to strict principles of sustainability: protecting natural resources and ecosystems, supporting the local economies where the plants are grown, safeguarding the rights of producers, and ensuring responsible development throughout the entire supply chain. . Perfumer: Carlos Benaïm, 2025.

listings.rawTitle: HUMBLE HOUSE | 阶上绿 Full Size 50ml | 1.7oz
listings.description: Eau de Toilette. . Humble House is the portrait of a secluded quiet dwelling, its hushed presence moving back and forth in time, moss on stone walls, slate roof green with age and muzzy ghosts stepping over a worn, indented door sill. A scholar's retreat with whispering scrolls and pages, celebrating the solitary nature of writing reflected in the beautiful assembly of papyrus, mastic and aromatic cypress.. The remains of a writing desk crumble below a blind window. The wall outside is overrun with ivy and tangled blackcurrant stems studded with ripening berries. Black-red plump acerbity lit by glimpses of narcotic narcissus.. Humble is an odd word, to some atmospheric and charming, implying quiet charms, unobtrusive presence, but to others it can be pejorative, meaning meek, ignoble and unassertive. Here it has been used by Nicolas Beaulieu to convey quietude, the often beautiful simplicity in unassuming forms and thoughts, made more beautiful still by the disarming subtlety of their presentation, mood and olfactive architecture.. A humid flurry of fern leaves and the herbal celery muskiness of angelica root add to the ambience of Humble House's fantasy surround. There is a distinctive odour of cool moss in the base that develops into a ghostly signature note, aided by the anisic curiosity of lentisque or mastic as it is sometimes known, valued for its spiky, clear resinous profile and excellent fixative properties.. There is such beautiful charisma and allure to Humble House. Perfumes this evocative are rare and Aromag and Nicolas Beaulieu have created an extraordinary composition, capturing the time passed after our scholar has tidied away his writings, walked out of the door and simply vanished.. . Composition: . Blackcurrant Bud LMR*, Citron. Ivy, Papyrus, Immortelle, Narcissus LMR*. Fern Leaves, Angelica Root, Lentisque LMR*, Moss LMR*, Cypress. The ingredients marked with an asterisk are natural materials. LMR stands for high-quality, sustainable natural materials exclusively developed by IFF. The sourcing of LMR materials ensures the protection of natural resources and ecosystems, supports the economy of the cultivation areas, safeguards the rights of producers, and achieves sustainable development throughout the entire process. . Perfumer: Nicolas Beaulieu, 2023.

listings.rawTitle: DISTANT LOVE | 长相思 Full Size 50ml | 1.7oz
listings.description: Eau de Parfum. . With Distant Love, Dominique Ropion has created a fascinating and enigmatic perfume for Aromag, centred around a fugitive rose, made elusive yet somehow strangely present by the use of grape leaves, wrapping the rosaceous vapours in sun-warmed vines, astringent foliage, new mown grass and the odour of unripe grape skins that becomes more pronounced as Distant Love warms up on skin. Ropion's grape leaf accord carries a tannic, astringent edge that expertly counterpoints the rose.. Distant Love is about balance and the shimmering veil through which we view love. One moment it is everything, all-consuming, a violent rose of desire, then it shifts focus and we sense its presence only at the edges of our vision. This elusiveness is enabled by a beautiful note of orris, its bruised powdery nature creating a lipstick-enhanced tissue of nostalgic allure. Orange blossom in the top notes and patchouli and vetiver in the base bookend the captivating drama of Ropion's rose, demonstrating once again his never-ending capacity to echo back and forth through time and offer us another nuanced portrait of the magnificent rose.. . Composition: . Orange Blossom LMR*, Grape Leaves. Rose*, Orris LMR*. Vetiver LMR*, Patchouli LMR*. The ingredients marked with an asterisk are natural materials. LMR stands for high-quality, sustainable natural materials exclusively developed by IFF. The sourcing of LMR materials ensures the protection of natural resources and ecosystems, supports the economy of the cultivation areas, safeguards the rights of producers, and achieves sustainable development throughout the entire process. . Perfumer: Dominique Ropion, 2023.

listings.rawTitle: WILD GARLIC | 野蒜 Full Size 50ml | 1.7oz
listings.description: Eau de Parfum. Wild Garlic is a provocative name for a fragrance. Many will immediately conjure the pervasive, thickly green odour of allium ursinum, the botanical name for wild garlic, growing by rivers and under trees in distinctively pungent mini forests. The smell is unmistakable, the pungent foliage and flowers used in a variety of cuisine, not least the redolent, palate-flooding pesto often made by serious foragers.. Wild Garlic does not smell like its heady inspiration, but a strange phantom of recognition roams through Dominique Ropion's fascinating composition, playing with our expectations and scent memories.. The initial opening of Wild Garlic is a shock, a spacious blast of crystal clear jade light, like walking into a vast cold Victorian-style greenhouse, chill winter sun bouncing off glass panes and stone, surrounded by an array of buds, stalks, leaves, flowers, potting compost, twine and a mix of oiled and rusted tools.. Ropion has composed an acerbic maelstrom of verdure, mingling vegetal wonder, tomato leaf, moist celery, lavender, and the pissy feral allure of blackcurrant leaves, dirty and astringent. Shiso leaf is allied to the woody orange of petitgrain, allowing the sweet basil mintiness of the shiso leaf to work its unique beauty.. There is no trace of actual garlicky greenness, but Ropion's inventive concept scent is witty, immediate and gloriously addictive, confounding the senses and demonstrating verve and vision.. Composition: . Black Currant Leaves, Petitgrain*, Shiso Leaves. Wild Garlic Leaves, Galbanum LMR*, Tomato Leaves, Celery Leaves, Lavender LMR*, Jasmine LMR*. Green Moss, Vetiver. The ingredients marked with an asterisk are natural materials. LMR stands for high-quality, sustainable natural materials exclusively developed by IFF. The sourcing of LMR materials ensures the protection of natural resources and ecosystems, supports the economy of the cultivation areas, safeguards the rights of producers and achieves sustainable development throughout the entire process. . Perfumer: Dominique Ropion, 2023.

listings.rawTitle: OAK TREE | 许拍 Full Size 50ml | 1.7oz
listings.description: Limited Edition Eau de Parfum. "Trees are the silent observers of civilization." . Oak Tree is a collaboration between Aromag and the HYLLA Hotel in Lijiang, which lies at the foot of the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain in Yunnan Province. Founded the same year as Aromag, HYLLA is a design hotel grounded in Eastern philosophy, preserving the wood-and-stone architecture of traditional Naxi buildings while curating vintage furniture, rare books and artworks from across centuries. The hotel has preserved 90% of its native forest landscape.. At the centre of HYLLA's gardens stands a century-old oak tree named Xu Pai, which carries the blessings of the local Naxi culture and serves as the heart of the hotel's relationship with time, place and the natural world. As part of a stay at HYLLA, guests can participate in Dawn Rituals, an early morning observance of writing letters to the future under the benevolence of the oaken branches.. Oak Tree is a study of Xu Pai's place in the landscape and its continuing symbolic resonance, part of Aromag's Long Ballad Collection: a series of collaborative fragrances inspired by Li Bai's poems celebrating friendship across time and distance.. Perfumer Frank Voelkl has built the composition from natural woods and resins sourced from across the world. Smoky guaiac wood from Paraguay and a modern iteration of inky Macedonian oakmoss bring deep, earthy forest atmosphere. Somali frankincense and Indonesian gurjun balsam provide cold resin notes carrying a hint of snow-capped mountain air.. At the heart of the base is Firmenich's exclusive Labdanum Vulcain from Spain, extracted using a heat-melting technique that intensifies the resin into something darker, warmer, smokier, with the depth of aged leather.. Oak Tree feels ephemeral, a ghost wood, but do not get lulled into any dismissive mood. The perfume has been blended with consummate skill to wear and live in like a talisman. While there is a whisper of structure, Oak Tree is more a mood, an instinctual offering of calm contemplation, a momentary oasis of stillness and surrender to our overworked senses.. Oak Tree has an aura of hushed power, a portrait of a man-made landscape surrounding an ancient living thing that has stood for centuries, watching our world go raucously by.. Composition: . Spanish Cypress*, Somali Olibanum (SFE). Macedonian Oakmoss*, Indonesian Gurjun Balsam*, Paraguayan Guaiac Wood*. Spanish Labdanum (Vulcain)*. The ingredients marked with an asterisk are natural materials. SFE stands for Super Fluid Extraction, indicating that the natural ingredients are extracted using supercritical fluid extraction technology. . Perfumer: Frank Voelkl, 2024.

Eau de Toilette. Cashmere is a heavenly perfume of intense comfort, drenched in white musks, layers of talcum powder, freshly washed skin, white tea and clean laundry. Its initial simplicity develops into something emotional, and it becomes somehow impossible to tell where Cashmere ends and your skin begins.. The delicate downiness has been rendered with skill and gossamer beauty over a foundation of lacteous woods, powdery musks, orris and tender vanilla. Guaiac wood adds a frisson of snuffed out candle that complements ambrette seed, sometimes known as Musk Mallow, a tropical hibiscus and the only naturally occurring plant-derived musk.. Master Perfumer Olivier Cresp is one of the most well-known and diverse perfumers currently at work, equally at home with masstige brands and independent houses. Famous for Dolce & Gabbana's Light Blue, his own Akro line and part of the team that created the divisive but game-changing Angel for Thierry Mugler, so much of his work concerns transparency, working with skin musks, aquatic nuances and the addiction of glassy floral compositions.. Cashmere is a masterly piece of perfumery. Jasmine and sparkling aldehydes are key to its form and the way it holds to skin, suffused with nostalgia and solace. A perfume of exquisite invisibility.. Composition: . Aldehydes. Ambrette Seed*, Jasmine Sambac SFE*. White Musk, Sandalwood (West Indian)*, Sandalwood (Australian)*, Cashmere Wood, Orris, Guaiacwood*, Vanilla. The notes marked with an asterisk are derived from natural ingredients. SFE stands for Super Fluid Extraction, indicating that the natural ingredients are extracted using supercritical fluid extraction technology. . Perfumer: Olivier Cresp, 2023.

listings.rawTitle: COUP DE FOUDRE | 怦然心动 Full Size 50ml | 1.7oz
listings.description: Eau de Parfum. Coup de Foudre translates as "lightning strike" and is used by the French to describe the shock of love at first sight. It was composed by Loc Dong, the first Asian fine fragrance perfumer in the industry, whose blockbuster creations include Calvin Klein's Euphoria and Giorgio Armani's Acqua di Gioia. Mentored by Dominique Ropion, Sophia Grojsman and Carlos Benaim, Dong brings a sense of boldness and emotional clarity to everything he composes.. The heart of Coup de Foudre is a lustrous dewy white rose with sap green veins, early morning light illuminating unfurling petals. A creamy bouquet of jasmine, ylang-ylang and lily of the valley holds the rose in delicate place, tinted by the rooty powder of orris and kissed with the juicy, translucent fruitiness of lychee.. Loc Dong floods Coup de Foudre with aldehydes that add champagne pizzazz and buoyant radial glow. Aldehydic perfumes have a satisfyingly sparkling tenor throughout the history of perfumery, and here they lift the rose into something effervescent and luminous.. The top notes are a blast of bitter-green phosphorescence with cardamom and eucalyptus laying down a soothing framework for the rose, smudged at the edges by rooty vetiver. Oscillating between a tailored floral refinement and something a little more reckless, Loc Dong draws out the enduring beauty of roses and their eternal allure.. Composition: ,. Guatemalan Cardamom*, Green Accords, Aldehydes, Australian Eucalyptus Leaves*. Damask Rose*, Moroccan Orris*, French Jasmine*, Madagascar Ylang-Ylang*, Lily of the Valley, African Geranium*. Haitian Vetiver*. Ingredients marked with an asterisk are natural raw materials. . Perfumer: Loc Dong, 2025.

listings.rawTitle: ROSE EN FEU | 开到荼蘼 Full Size 50ml | 1.7oz
listings.description: Eau de Parfum. Rose en Feu is the work of Jean-Louis Sieuzac, one of the most celebrated perfumers of the twentieth century and the nose behind Bel Ami for Hermès, Sagamore for Lancôme and part of the team that created the original legendary Opium for Yves Saint Laurent in 1977.. In keeping with its fiery name, this is a huge petrolic rose, carmine petals on fire with the stygian burn of cypriol, sometimes known as nagarmotha. The tarred and singed woodiness of cypriol has a sensational ignition as Rose en Feu hits skin, beautifully enhanced by cardamom, cinnamon and cypress with the mulched scent of conifers.. Sieuzac has built Rose en Feu around a dramatic conflagration of rose that smells of lightning-struck dark red roses while at the same time wearing on the skin like the finest gossamer silk. Fire can be cleansing, voracious, dangerous, but can also make way for change and transformation. The aftermath of forest and scrub burning may seem violent but through ash and cindered wood, seeds reach again for the sun. There is a sense of watching a Dutch still life of tousled blooms on fire in a darkened gallery.. The masala of spices, smoke woods and the bridging beauty of fragrant elemi resin create a beguiling setting for the Turkish rose; this in turn transitions smoothly into a base of vetiver, frankincense and an earthy patchouli. Tendrils of green smoke spiral upwards, enriching the singed curl of rose petals.. Composition: . Elemi LMR, French Cypress LMR, Indian Papyrus LMR, Sri Lankan Cinnamon Bark LMR, West African Ginger LMR, Malaysian Nutmeg LMR, Madagascar Pink Pepper LMR. Turkish Rose Absolute LMR. Haitian Vetiver LMR, Indonesian Patchouli LMR, Somali Frankincense (Olibanum) LMR. LMR (Laboratoire Monique Rémy), a high-end natural ingredients division of IFF, sources materials from dedicated plantations around the world. This rose absolute comes from Turkey, where over 130 years of cultivation and extraction have shaped its quality. Rich and full-bodied, it reveals a dense floral character with a depth reminiscent of fine wine. . Perfumer: Jean-Louis Sieuzac, 2025.

listings.rawTitle: FIREWORK | 白日焰火 Full Size 50ml | 1.7oz
listings.description: Eau de Toilette. TThe list of materials used by Maxime Exler for his confounding perfume Firework might predispose you to expect something singed and burned, cold nights and the distinctive dry sulphurous drift of spent fireworks. Aromag, as ever, has a more considered vision.. The Chinese invented fireworks - 花火 (huāhuǒ) , literally 'fire flowers' - essentially decorative bombs of saltpetre pyrotechnics honed into extraordinarily timed displays of mineral-rich innards that dazzled onlookers with colour and sound. Italians are generally assumed to be the first users of fireworks in religious ceremonies and public celebrations.. Aromag's Firework is a shock in its refusal to be predictable. This is a portrait of the firework process itself: the materials, the mortar, powder, accelerants, stars, lift charge, paper, card and wood. All of this rises, peaks and fades into the aftermath of the pyrotechnics, spent materials reflected in nostalgic composing.. There is an unusual bitter-green note in the upper reaches of Firework, olibanum and mournful myrrh camouflaging the initial hit of gunpowder. A ticklish grind of pepper adds noticeable texture. This opens the soaring space for beautifully assembled smokiness, tobacco and dark vanillic rum. The gunpowder glitters like stardust painted across the night sky.. Powdery grey-bruise orris, sandalwood, patchouli and supple guaiac wood infuse Firework with the sadness of dead pyrotechnics, burned paper, singed sky and the dissipating vapour of ephemeral spectacle. What a poignant thing Aromag's Firework is, a singular vision of scented fire flowers.. Composition: . Pepper*, Olibanum*, Myrrh, Gunpowder. Tobacco, Incense, Rum*. Orris*, Sandalwood*, Patchouli*, Leather, Guaiacwood. The notes marked with an asterisk are derived from natural ingredients. . Perfumer: Maxime Exler, 2023.

Eau de Parfum. There have been endless discussions about the nature of white; is it a colour, or all colours? White light can be broken down in a prismatic array of tones and there is also the consideration of transparency versus opacity.. As a colour, it can veil, render opaque or glow with reflective beauty. Take Greco-Roman sculpture; to us now, the legacy is bone achromatism, pieces of bodies, heads, horses, hands and musculature that glows as lit from within. Yet they were never meant to be seen like this, the sculptures often brightly painted, some garishly so. Yet we continue to praise the sublime monochrome, the milky immaculacy of such work.. Using white often means that form and decoration are more emphasised, an artistic rendering of snow on landscapes, blurring mingled emphasis with cached shapes. Ashley Balavoine's White simmers in its ivory luminosity, a perfumed work of art, all of the complex and fascinating materials designated white, so in effect the fragrance is a multi-exposure of colour and its own absence. Essentially an exquisite portrait of white musks, powder, delicate tea and anisic petals, White smells like an ethereal gift, a scent of immense grace and opalescence.. There are parallels to be found in the nacreous beauty of Blanc de Chine porcelain, made in Dehua in Fujian province. It is the only form of Chinese porcelain that does not use any coloured decoration, but this is not to say it is colourless. The flawless fusion of body and glaze, the ivory gloss allows a clarity of form and attention to detail as opposed to ornate colourways.. There is lustre, sheen and silence in Aromag's White, a translucency akin to holding fine porcelain to a light source and watching it glow. Despite the sizable list of white-themed materials, the overall effect is of a flawless perfumed wall. None of the ingredients have been used to stand out or interrupt the experience. It is a difficult mood to achieve.. White is an intimate essay in necessary comfort. Only once it is on your skin do you realise how much you have missed it, despite perhaps never having worn it; it has a unique impact on the senses. Laundry, clean dry skin, fresh sheets, ephemeral powders coalesce in body, form and olfactive glaze.. Like Blanc de Chine, the brilliancy lies in balancing technique, glazing and textured form. The herbal balsamic glow of white calamus, cold angelica, soft white smoke and pale orris are enfolded from below by consoling synthetic musks that have beautiful longevity and romance. It is hard not to fall in love with the elegance of White, swooning to the luminous osmosis of skin and scent.. Composition: . White Anise, White Calamus. Angelica, White Lacquer Wood, White Olibanum SFE*, White Tea SFE*. White Incense, White Orris, White Cedarwood, White Musk SFE*, White Vetiver*. The notes marked with an asterisk are derived from natural ingredients that meet environmental standards. SFE stands for Super Fluid Extraction, indicating that the natural ingredients are extracted using supercritical fluid extraction technology, which is more environmentally friendly. . Perfumer: Ashley Balavoine, 2023.

listings.rawTitle: INKCENSE | 松烟黛墨 Full Size 50ml | 1.7oz
listings.description: Eau de Parfum. . It is fitting that the earliest perfume launched by Aromag was Inkcense, because no other fragrance in the collection embodies the house philosophy so purely: scent as ink, skin as paper, the liubai concept made wearable.. Created by Frank Voelkl, the talented nose responsible for olfactive hits such as You for Glossier and the ubiquitous Santal 33 for Le Labo, which for a while seemed like the signature scent of London, Inkcense is a delicate masterpiece, a perfume of scented washes, negative space and aesthetic balance.. Liubai is an integral concept of eastern art, especially Chinese painting, essentially concerned with the deliberate leaving of space in compositional terms, recognising the importance of blankness. Inkcense is a perfumed manifestation of this atramental fumy concept on an aquatic wash across the palest of papery musks and gentle amber.. Scent as ink, skin as paper. The imprint of kumquat sweetens the top notes but it is the elegant bleed of smoke and Voelkl's perfectly calibrated ink accord that illuminates the skin beneath the material body of Inkcense, intermittent pigments, hushed and moreish. The transparency is sublime, wearing Inkcense is like the most precious calligraphy, soothing words flowing over the body.. . Composition: . Kumquat, Incense SFE, Ink Accord. Lotus Flower, Cedarwood*, Sandalwood*. Patchouli*, Ambrette*, White Musk, Amber. The ingredients marked with an asterisk are natural materials. SFE stands for Super Fluid Extraction, indicating that the natural ingredients are extracted using supercritical fluid extraction technology, which is more environmentally friendly. The White Musk in this perfume is an exclusive musk molecule from Firmenich, making the musk scent soft and translucent, akin to the impression of ink on rice paper. . Perfumer: Frank Voelkl, 2018.

listings.rawTitle: INKCENSE MUSKY MOONLIGHT | 松烟黛墨·麝香月 Full Size 50ml | 1.7oz
listings.description: Eau de Parfum. . Inkcense Musky Moonlight is technically a flanker to Inkcense but is in fact much more: a revisualisation of Voelkl's beautiful original scent for Aromag that mirrors the original while darkening it. The heightened verdancy provided by a dose of balmy terpenes, sap and cardamom infused frankincense shifts the composition into shadow.. The suggestion of prickly pine needles is soothed by a bruised lavender note, reminiscent of fingers rubbing purple-blue flowers in a sultry garden. The more muscular musks add body, while the smoky rendering is bolstered by elemi resin and the tactile vegetal leather tone of labdanum.. Though there is no obvious ink in the list of ingredients, the onyx moonlight implication hangs over the perfume like the aftermath of an extinguished candle. Voelkl has lovingly mirrored his original Inkcense adding an arboreal emerald vibe, suggesting enough darkness to complement his key Inkcense composition.. . Composition: . Cardamon*, Kumquat, Pine*, Lavender*, White Musk. Jasmine, Olibanum SFE*, Cedarwood*, Patchouli*. Musk, Labdanum*, Elemi SFE*, Vetiver SFE*. he ingredients marked with an asterisk are natural materials. SFE stands for Super Fluid Extraction, indicating that the natural ingredients are extracted using supercritical fluid extraction technology, which is more environmentally friendly. . Perfumer: Frank Voelkl.

listings.rawTitle: SILK ROAD | 夜光杯 Full Size 50ml | 1.7oz
listings.description: Eau de Parfum. The name Silk Road echoes romantically with ancient history, stories of trade and the connecting of civilisations, of peoples, the transporting of precious textiles, porcelain, tea, spices and manuscripts. The Silk Road opened up the east, China, Japan and Korea, allowing a mutually beneficial flow of goods from cities like Constantinople (now Istanbul) and Venice, enriching the coffers of merchants at either end of the routes. In keeping with the locales, various routes and romanticism, perfumer Frank Voelkl has conjured up a vast airy composition that blows across the skin, snagging at the senses.. The west discovered tea through trade routes and English and Dutch trading companies, so it is an appropriate aromatic top note with a dash of lemon, fragrantly brewed and warm, this allows time for the main player to emerge, an elegantly appointed wine accord with gooseberry and pomegranate facets, blended perfectly with the altar riches of frankincense and bitter myrrh. Clove and rose deepen the fermentation vibe of the wine and a surprising use of sesame adds a unique smeared nuttiness and milky comfort to proceedings.. Woods, patchouli, benzoin resin, sparkling vetiver and the herbaceous evergreen scent of cypress. These base notes firmly anchor Silk Road to the skin, creating a long-lasting impression of olfactive terrain, a journey of scented intent, punctuated by night fires to keep warm, the dry heat of the day, and a wine accord that is nothing short of bacchanalian.. Composition: . Tea SFE*, Citron*. Sesame SFE*, Olibanum SFE*, Myrrh, Clove*, Rose SFE*, Wine SFE*. Sandalwood*, Oak, Patchouli SFE*, Cedarwood, Benzoin, Cypress*, Vetiver*, Labdanum*. The notes marked with an asterisk are derived from natural ingredients that meet environmental standards. SFE stands for Super Fluid Extraction, indicating that the natural ingredients are extracted using supercritical fluid extraction technology, which is more environmentally friendly. . Perfumer: Frank Voelkl, 2023.

Eau de Cologne. A tender caress of cologne is an intriguing concept, but that is what we have in Miko from Aromag courtesy of perfumer Florian Gallo. When considering the nature of colognes, one of the oldest styles of perfume thanks to its citric freshness and evaporation creating a cooling effect, we automatically think of the diversity of the citrus family. From bitter bergamot and tangy lime to the exotic perfume of yuzu and Buddha's Hand, each fruit adds unique textural and flavour profiles to compositions.. One of the associated myths of citrus perfumes is their fleeting nature, the molecules are small and generally part of top notes, they seem to shift off skin quickly. And yes they can seem ephemeral but that is an essential part of their nature. To energise, refresh and dazzle.. Miko is a sparkling concoction of addictive citrus notes, with petitgrain, bitter orange, bergamot, lemon, lime, orange, mandarine and a rub of marjoram in the solar-lit top notes and neroli and indolic orange blossom in the heady heart.. The giddy swathe of citrus runs a gamut from bitter-green and oozing with juice to tangy sweetness and floral musks. The key to Miko is the two creamy indolic notes of orange blossom and jasmine sambac, both rich with hot skin, erotic radiance and a genuine sense of unfurling petals. They reek of hazy sun, flesh half in, half out of shade.. The modern musk notes in the base of Miko are smooth and delicious, exalting cabreuva wood, patchouli and rooty green vetiver up through the citrus notes, ensuring harmony and lasting clarity to a beautifully modern riff of the classic citrus cologne.. Composition: . Petitgrain*, Bitter Orange*, Bergamot*, Lemon*, Lime*, Orange*, Mandarine*, Marjolaine* , Clary Sage*, Sage*, Pine*. Neroli*, Orange Blossom*, Jasmin Sambac*. Vetiver*, Patchouli*, Cabreuva*, Muscenone®, Helvetolide®. The notes marked with * are derived from pure natural materials that meet environmental standards. . Perfumer: Florian Gallo, 2024.

Eau de Parfum. . Byronic Hero is a velvet night of charismatic passion and doomed love. It broods on skin, enigmatic and rebellious.. The penumbra swirls around a central core of rose, saffron and clove, classic perfume notes but twisted here into something gothic. The initial impression is surreal, Lynchian even, driverless cars careening down night roads, headlights catching the flickering glow of bonfires ablaze by the sides of the highway.. Would Byron be a biker if he was alive today? Poetically committed to the life of a lone rider, wrapped in an old leather jacket, stained and scarred by a lifetime of random encounters. It is tempting to imagine this as Byronic Hero roars ingeniously off skin.. Under certain conditions, particular roses smell petrolic, noir and crimson, shimmering with hot chrome. The heart of Byronic Hero is a viscous fir balsam note that sets green fire to the rose while earthy patchouli hints at counterculture dissent. The final fitting descent of this left-field hero is an artful diesel exhaust effect that spills a dark rose sillage into the darkness.. . Composition: . Clove, Saffron. Rose, Fir Balsam. Oud, Patchouli, Diesel Exhaust. Perfumer: Trey Taylor, 2025. . inci list: Alcohol Denat., Fragrance (parfum), Benzyl Benzoate, Benzyl Alcohol, Geraniol, Eugenol, Citronellol, Farnesol, Linalool, Limonene, Citral .

Eau de Parfum. Priscus is a glorious boozy stone-fruit wonder, ripe with plum, blossom and liqueur.. The opening is beautifully detailed: sun-warmed plums with burgundy skins, red-green flesh beneath, juice staining the fingers. The realism of the fruit is given an unexpected gloss, a polished, almost lacquered sheen that keeps the composition from becoming purely edible. Soon, the fruit begins to soften into compote: plums collapsing into pulp, simmered with cinnamon bark and an imagined dash of something darker and headier.. In Japan, plum wine is known as umeshu, made by macerating tart ume plums in alcohol. Though often called a wine, it is technically closer to a liqueur, with facets of ripening plum, apricot and peach. Some versions macerate the whole ume fruit, allowing the pit to impart a faint bitter almond note.. That sense of detail runs through Priscus. Plum blossom, plum wine and ripe plum spiral together, deepened by heliotrope with its cherry-pie and amandine softness. Osmanthus adds a quiet tea-like fruitiness, while immortelle brings its warm, shrubby, golden xanthous glow. The result is fermented, plush and gently strange: a perfume that wears dreamily, shifting stage by stage as it warms and blooms on skin.. Composition: . Plum Blossom, Plum Wine, Cinnamon Bark. Plum, Heliotrope, Osmanthus, Immortelle. Patchouli, Blond Woods. Perfumer: Trey Taylor, 2026. inci list: Alcohol Denat., Fragrance (parfum), Benzyl Benzoate, Benzyl Alcohol, Limonene, Linalool, Eugenol, Cinnamic Alcohol, Cinnamal, Citral, Geraniol, Citronellol, Coumarin, Farnesol, Isoeugenol .

Eau de Parfum. Frisson D’Hiver, or Thrill of Winter, opens coldly with a dramatic whoosh of unexpected acerbic frost adorning citrus orchards. A snap frost that glitters in early morning sun.. This is not a winter perfume however, it smells of transition, the beautiful starkness of winter, segueing into the burgeoning brighter low-light of spring. Accompanied by the inevitable thaw of soil and water, foliage craves sunlight and trees adorn themselves in green. Plants, sleepy with chlorophyll dreams unfurl.. The buzzy sensuality of orange blossom illuminates a heart rich with lily of the valley, rose and jasmine. The ice accord that opened Frisson D’Hiver melts away and the flowers revel in resins, vanilla and a skyful of white musks.. It is the movement of glacial suspension to solar glow that makes this clever composition such a joy to wear.. Composition: . Ice, Bergamot, Orange Blossom. Lily of the Valley, Rose, Jasmine. Labdanum, Vanilla, White Musk. Perfumer: Trey Taylor, 2025. inci list: Alcohol Denat., Fragrance (parfum), Benzyl Salicylate, Linalool, Geraniol, Benzyl Benzoate, Hydroxycitronellal, Benzyl Alcohol, Citronellol, Limonene, Citral, Eugenol, Farnesol, Cinnamic Alcohol, Isoeugenol .

Eau de Parfum. Ruche suggests its nature through its name: a gathering, a decorative fold, a soft arrangement of texture and light.. Sparkling spices open the scent with a lifted, aerated clarity. Pink pepper, black pepper set up the central tension of Ruche: ripe raspberry cut through with piercing galbanum. Green, resinous and sharp, it pulls the fruit away from sweetness and into leaf, thorned stem with crisp botanical bite. Nutmeg bridges the two beautifully, milky, lightly woody and citrus-bright.. Raspberry brings its unmistakable summer pleasure, tart, red, juicy and lightly tannic. Its older linguistic associations with raspis, a sweet rose-coloured wine, feel beautifully in keeping with Ruche’s flushed, aromatic mood, gently intoxicating without becoming heavy.. Geranium gives the composition a crisp floral-green lift, while patchouli and sandalwood anchor it unobtrusively, smoothing the brightness into a supple trail that remains breezy and chic. Ruche moves between surprise and familiarity, trailing a graceful sensuality that feels effortless to wear.. Composition: . Black Pepper, Pink Pepper, Nutmeg. Galbanum, Raspberry. Patchouli, Sandalwood. Perfumer: Trey Taylor, 2025. inci list: Alcohol Denat., Fragrance (parfum), Linalool, Limonene, Benzyl Benzoate, Benzyl Alcohol, Farnesol, Isoeugenol, Eugenol .

Eau de Parfum. . Sour Diesel takes one of perfumery’s more provocative references and makes it wonderfully provocative.. The cannabis accord is not treated as a novelty effect, but as a complex green atmosphere: bitter, piney, resinous and narcotic, with the faint mulched volatility of crushed leaves and smoke settling in warm air. Beneath it runs the suggested shimmer of diesel, piquant and herbal rather than heavy, giving the fragrance its glint of petrolic charge.. Rhubarb cuts straight through the haze. Bright, tart and blush-coloured, it brings a sharp fruit acidity that prevents the composition from sinking into dazed languor. In perfumery, rhubarb is wonderfully malleable. It can suggest green apple, citrus, damp soil, strawberry and raw stalks snapped open at the stem. Here, its acerbic brightness lifts the cannabis accord and makes the whole structure feel more vivid.. Geranium adds a subtle rosy-green glow, while juniper berries sharpen the heart with their cool, aromatic bite. The result is bold and attention-grabbing, but not murky. Sour Diesel has a telluric ease, marrying iconic fruit and narcotic haze with surprising freshness. Defiant, piquant and oddly uplifting, it is one of Serviette’s most fascinating compositions.. . Composition: . Rhubarb, Pink Pepper. Geranium, Juniper Berry, Kush. Patchouli, Cedar, Sandalwood. Perfumer: Trey Taylor, 2025. . inci list: Alcohol Denat., Fragrance (parfum), Geraniol, Hydroxycitronellal, Citronellol, Farnesol, Linalool, Limonene, Citral .

Extrait de Parfum. Mother stands for comfort. Mother will hide the murderer. Mother hides the madman. Mother will stay mum. From ‘Mother Stands For Comfort’. Words & Music by Kate Bush. Mother’s Milk, the latest launch from Eris Perfumes is a disquieting and hauntingly beautiful gourmand perfume. Created by Master Perfumer Antoine Lie and Eris Artistic Director and perfume historian Barbara Herman, it is an unsettling yet compulsive study of our associated emotional responses to the concept and interpretations of mother and motherhood.. The phrase Mother’s Milk is loaded with beauty, safety and natural maternal power. Most people agree that breastfeeding creates a vital psychological and physical bond between mother and child. Nutrients, antibodies, comfort and security are passed on. It is a primal channelling of nourishment, protection, love and fear.. Motherhood is eternally under attack, mostly at the hands of the patriarchy and religious zealots who want to control the female body using foetus rights as an excuse. The very cradle of existence, the natural cycle of motherhood, something that should be protected and celebrated has been corrupted by brutal interference, skewed laws and the implied mindset that women are incapable of making decisions regarding their own bodies. The shockingly prescient The Handmaid’s Tale by Margaret Atwood originally published in 1985 showed us the world we have now in many places.. It is a strange thought that perfumery might strive to encapsulate such a vast arena of emotions, but then Antoine Lie is not exactly a conventional perfumer and Barbara has a scrupulous eye for historical detail. She makes us aware that while the history and development of perfume has been millennia in the making, what is often seen as mere adornment or beautification has in fact been loaded with coded symbolism. Sexuality, power, weapon, ritual and identity. All reflected in composition and design.. Mother’s Milk is a subversive adult lullaby, presenting as something gentle, soothing and nostalgic, all the while concealing the latent transgression of a transparent trojan horse. White and pale pink, malleable purity, suggestively unsettled by the insertion of a bitter, animalic suede note that oscillates between velveteen nap and musky interference. Mother’s Milk is dazzling gourmand work, in fact it feels like something new, the delicious nostalgia of mother and baby, milk and vanilla, talcum, baby oil and barrier creams.. The delicate faded pink hue of the juice suggests pastel tea roses blanching before they fall to the ground. A Virgin Suicides bedroom with scattered baby pink and ivory Lisbon sister detritus. But Mother’s Milk invites a deeper dive than most perfumes. It is the inclusion of a buttery orris note derived from the precious rhizomes of Bavarian iris that transmutes Mother’s Milk into a perfume of celestial fascination and violaceous romance.. The addictive nostalgia of hot milk, orris, blushing rose is good mother, baby’s head, comfort, refuge and memories of innocence. Lie then introduces a darkened animalic suede note, supple and subversive, a deliberate shadow cast through the pervasive lacteous solace. This suggestion that motherhood is not all perfection or even appreciated, that disturbance is internal and external, the sly woody suede works in perfect disharmony with the silvered orris and poignant milky vanilla.. Mother’s Milk is an exceptionally beautiful perfume, Barbara Herman and Antoine continue to offer us unique compositions and sensual anomalies that we have no idea we need until we inhale them and craving kicks in. Each perfume to date has been distinguished by imagination and the duo’s exploration of past perfume tropes and exploding them with contemporary virtuosity and technological elan.. It is hard to shake the mood and beauty of Mother’s Milk, an atmospheric and shifting land of mothers, followed by a silhouette of disquiet, walking through the comfort.. Composition: . Milk Accord, Bulgarian Damascena Rose Oil. Bavarian Orris, Suede Accord. Vanilla, Columbian Cacao, Musk Accord, Sandalwood. Perfumer: Antoine Lie, 2026. inci list: Alcohol Denat., Parfum, Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes, Vanillin, Geranyl Acetate, Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone, Citronellol, Hexamethylindanopyran, BHT, Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane, Ethylhexyl Salicylate, Coumarin, Rose Ketones, Rose Flower Oil/Extract, Geraniol .

Limited Edition Parfum. Talisman is a scent of smoke in stone, gelid air blowing forested green weather. The layers part as it develops as opposed to blending overtly and this gives Talisman a distinctive alertness and impact, the gin stylings of juniper, pink pepper and chilly angelica rinsing through resins, amber and white musks.. Talismans are objects believed to carry protective force, often small enough to wear or carry. The dreamcatcher appearing on Talisman was chosen by perfumer Nata Dishlyiuk as a personal symbol of protection. Dreamcatchers originate in Ojibwe tradition, and we acknowledge that provenance here.. The cool woody backdrop of Talisman is elegantly suffused with more piquant elements, particularly the elemi resin and sparkling pink pepper. What remains is the ghost of incense in stone, a ghostly presence in the evergreen endgame.. Composition: . Elemi Supercritical Fluid Extraction, Pink Pepper Supercritical Fluid Extraction, Fresh air accord. Incense, Juniper Berry CO2, Black Pepper, Angelica. Incense Resin, Labdanum, Alaskan Cypress, Virginian Cedar, Patchouli, Amber, Musk. Perfumer: Nata Dishlyiuk, 2024. inci list: Tetramethyl acetyloctahydronaphthalenes, Citrus Aurantium Bergamia Peel Oil, Citrus Limon Peel Oil, Linalool, Limonene, Benzyl Benzoate, Carvone, Eugenol, BHT, Isoeugenol, Benzyl Alcohol, Citral, Benzaldehyde, Geraniol, Citronellol, Cinnamyl Alcohol .

Limited Edition Parfum. . A Dream of Marigolds. Songe de Tagete feels like a reflective companion piece to an earlier Sentire X Sainte Cellier perfume, Songe de Narcisse, both of them intensively detailed and revelatory. If you remove the ‘e’ and leave Song of … Marigolds it would reflect the gorgeous choral canon of materials that perfumer Nata Dyshliuk has composed into a scent of tremulous arid beauty.. Tagetes, known as cempasúchil, or flowers of the dead, are native to Mexico and other Latin American countries. This fierce new perfume gives centre stage to one of perfumery’s unsung flowers. We often think of them as marigolds, the name deriving from Mary’s Gold, due to the often intensely golden pompom blooms that also come in yellow, vivid orange and white.. Unusually the pungent scent of tagetes is present in both flowers and foliage. Their solar ubiquity during the Mexican Dia de al Muertos celebrations is an indication of their important symbolism (flowers as golden as sun ) and the scent of flowers and stems, strong enough to entice and guide the souls of the dead. Houses, doorways, graves, cemetery paths and family altars are decorated riotously with tagetes and the air is saturated with a musky green miasma.. In Songe de Tagete, the striking perfume of the plant is enhanced by the smoky capsicum odour of galbanum resin and bitter-jade blackcurrant leaf. Tagetes can have a complex array of facets, very much dependent on our familiarity with smelling the flowers and foliage. It can present as piquant and sweetly fumed, with cannabis and herbal facets. Galbanum is a tenacious head note that develops throughout compositions. Nata has added the white cleanliness of lily of the valley and a soft iris to cushion and float the marigold into a base of rooty vetiver, musky ambrette and a moist scrunch of oakmoss.. Everything comes together with beguiling beauty. There is floral enigma and musky overload, a smeared vintage echo of ruthless chypré tailoring. At once a hymn to an oft-neglected flower and a perfume of potent ambition, Songe de Tagete is a dream of exhilarating gardens, redolent with sensual song.. . Composition: . Galbanum, Cassis Leaf Absolute, Green Grass. Marigold, Lily of the Valley, Iris. Vetiver, Ambrette, Oakmoss. Perfumer: Nata Dyshliuk, 2026. Label Illustrated by Johanna Kwiat. . inci list: Tetramethyl acetyloctahydronaphthalenes, Hydroxycitronellal, Citrus Aurantium Bergamia Peel Oil, Benzyl Salicylate, Amyl Salicylate, alphaAmylcinnamaldehyde, Alpha Isomethyl Ionone, Citronellol, Geraniol, Linalool, Limonene, Pinenes, Eucalyptus Globulus absolute, BHT, alpha-Terpineol, Eugenol, Citral, Rose Ketones, Alpha-Terpinene, Coumarin, Terpinolene, Terpineol .

Limited Edition Parfum. Santal Soie is a delicious enveloping gourmand of vanilla-robed sandalwood with a frisson of sticky carnality at its persuasive heart. First impressions are of a capricious caramelised orange, coated lightly in chocolate but a singed lavender and aromatic geranium pairing soon soften this as the ornate build of the base notes begins to assert itself.. The blend of a moreish vanilla glaze and tonka absolute with its almondine clove and hay vibe make for an alluring mantle for Mysore sandalwood and a perfectly judged carnal musk accord that a perfectly judged carnal musk accord that whispers subtly of flesh desired.. The silken flow and drape of Santal Soie is gloriously flattering and while wearing it, one’s nose returns over and over again to an anointed wrist.. Composition: . Bitter Orange, Sicilian Bergamot, Ceylon Cinnamon. Immortelle absolute, Bulgarian Lavender, Bourbon Geranium. Vanilla Glaze Accord, Tonka Bean Absolute, Mysore sandalwood, Carnal Musk Accord. Perfumer: Nata Dishlyiuk, 2026. inci list: Tetramethyl acetyloctahydronaphthalenes, Limonene, Linalyl Acetate, Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil, Citrus Aurantium Bergamia Peel Oil, Santalum Album Oil, Santalol, Vanillin, Linalool, Coumarin, Lavandula Oil, Pelargonium Graveolens Flower Oil, BHT, Alpha Terpeniol, Geraniol, Citronellol, Geranyl Acetate, Terpineol, Camphor, Beta-Caryophyllene, Terpinolene .

Limited Edition Parfum. As the name suggests Fjord 29 is cold, glacial with a huge whoosh of glittering, breathtaking materials that open like water, air and ice simultaneously.. Nata has created a crisp invigorating twist on an aquatic chypré, with seaweed absolute and sea salt blowing in on fresh air through fir trees, scented with chill mint, lavender and fern. Clary sage adds a musky green leather note while oakmoss, patchouli and aromatic cedarwood anchor this remarkable perfume and provide a stable, long lasting fade.. Fjord 29 has an intriguing gelid vibe, like the scent of Antarctic ice cores, those long tubes of ice extracted to help scientists study millennia of global atmospheric change. They contain captured bubbles of atmosphere, trapped gases, volcanic ash, algae, dust and marine aerosols.. There is now the Ice Memory Foundation, a sanctuary for the multitude of cores holding onto their secrets. Fjord 29 suggests the mystery and isolation of these cores, mingled with bright sun glinting off ice and crashy blue seas. A hint of brittle freezer air and ice on aluminium floats under the marine brilliance.. The drydown is impressive, notes ebb and flow, spike and glisten, dip and soar. Each material has a role to play and has been integrated and delineated with attention to effect and beauty. Fjord 29 is a ingenious and significant addition to the Sentire x Sainte Cellier collection.. Composition: . Eucalyptus, Fir Balsam Absolute, Fresh Air Accord. Sea Salt, Clary Sage Absolute, Spanish Lavender. Oakmoss, Patchouli, Seaweed Absolute, Virginian Cedarwood. Perfumer: Nata Dishlyiuk, 2026. inci list: Tetramethyl acetyloctahydronaphthalenes, Linalool, Juniperus Virginiana Oil, Lavandula Oil, Linalyl Acetate, Citrus Aurantium Bergamia Peel Oil, Pogostemon Cablin Oil, Limonene, Geranyl Acetate, BHT, Terpineol, Camphor, Beta-Caryophyllene, Terpinolene, Citronellol, Geraniol .

listings.rawTitle: NOTES FROM THE SEED VAULT Full Size 50ml | 1.7oz
listings.description: Eau de Parfum. . Notes From The Seed Vault is one of the most distinctive and engrossing/spellbinding fragrances to materialise in years. Along with Aigue Monème and Fauve Evertue, it completes the dazzling debut triptych of perfumes from Iroise, all created by Julie Barretta.. Phantasmal and still, beautifully suggestive of botanical life in cold stasis, Notes From The Seed Vault echoes all the mystery and remoteness of the extraordinary Global Seed Vault on Spitsbergen in Svalbard, a Norwegian archipelago located in the Arctic ocean. Opened in 2008, the vault extends 130m into a sandstone mountain under strata of rock, and the startling opening resembles sharp debris fallen to earth, poking out of the landscape. Perpetual Repercussion, a striking artwork of illuminated fibre-optics, prisms, mirrors and highly reflective steel, by Danish artist Dyveke Sanne creates appropriate oddity and power at the entrance.. Julie’s hymn of seeds and grains is unlike anything else in perfumery. 1.3 million duplicate seeds have already been accessioned to the vault, (potential storage of 4.5 million) stored in aluminium bags, these replacing the original storage method of glass tubes.. What makes Notes From The Seed Vault so fascinating is the genuine sense of gelid, aloof location. It is almost impossible to read information about the seed vault without defaulting to pondering odours, conjuring up, despite the sealed seed storage, how such a vast project might smell, an imagined mingling of botanical and man-made edifices. All this set against the icy backdrop of Svalbard, snow, ice, midnight sun and arctic darkness.. Much of the fascination of Notes From The Seed Vault lies in the slow melting of glacial exposure to brumal warm reach. The suggestion of suspended animation and the metallic tang of iced water, that becomes a glorious embrace of powdered grains, finger crushed seeds and malted earth. There are a few more indications of notes with this composition. Carrot and ambrette seed have a delicious tellurian mood, suggesting powder dusted over private skin. Amaranth adds a sweet grassy note, touched by the warmth of steamed grains, while cotton seed suggests ground walnuts, pale musk and powdered earth.. The mix has a quiet yet persistent ambience. It is a joy to smell the shifts in structure as Notes From The Seed Vault evolves. One might argue that the hush and ambiguity are puzzling, but this would be a mistake. As with the Svalbard vault itself, with its arresting opening, we are led deeper into a compelling vault of modern necessity and precious hoarding. Notes From The Seed Vault may challenge the senses, but held within its ambiguity is a perfume of comfort and algid grace.. . Composition: . Carrot Seed. Amaranth. Ambrette Seed, Cotton Seed. Perfumer: Julie Barretta, 2025.

Eau de Parfum. The work of Henri Le Douanier Rosseau is instantly recognisable, a self-taught painter whose strange dark jungle foliage, wild beasts, mysterious faces and sense of suspended predation are now considered masterpieces, but during his lifetime were often derided by critics and fellow artists alike. However, his work seems eerie and psychologically rich, unsettling and dreamlike. Enigmatic works like The Snakecharmer reek of lush disturbance and profound experience.. Julie Barretta subconsciously conjures startling echoes of Rousseau’s world with the lush mesmerising Fauve Evertue, while at the same time creating an immersive world of jungle greens, rain, broken foliage, mulched leaf matter and the unsettling bitter scent of hot insect thoraxes.. Fauve Evertue is further proof, if needed of Julie’s unique olfactive gift, she is a creatrix of strange worlds perfumed with uncharted weather. A powdered herbal opens the scent, like the humid undergrowth exuding its odours after a thunderous storm. There is a metallic tang, something sharp and electrified as the hypnotic gloss of wild foliage drips ionised water.. The perfume has a disturbed quality, as if wearing exalts a pause in the endless cycle of weather. Deep within Fauve Évertue is something dark and roasted, an earthy bitterness mulched into humid undergrowth, pitted and churned by storms. Seeds split and shoots reach from shadows toward sunlight granted by the shimmering canopy above. A magical, singular perfume, composed with immense subtlety and skill, Fauve Evertue smells unknown and knowing simultaneously, blending lush realism and that Rousseau depiction of viridity and eldritch power.. Composition: . Glossy Leaves. Dark Fruits. Telluric Zing. Perfumer: Julie Barretta, 2023.

Eau de Parfum. Aigue Monème is a limpid green reflective scent that presents as the waterscape paintings of Norwegian artist Frits Thaulow reflected in the glass of brutalist architecture. Verdancy and kingfisher blues, shot through with flickering light bounced back with mysterious and challenging beauty.. Aigue Monème opens with a cold mineral shimmer: the glint of petrol on icy water, bitter and lucid, like a stream catching winter light. The water is chatty and unpredictable, clear as crystal, the riverbed an insight of glistening stones, algae, ribboning plants and lapped banks. First impressions are of cool caraway and crushed coriander seed, their aromatic chill sharpened by a dusting of black pepper. This cool aromatic opening has an anisic glassiness; look into the scent and it seems to stare back with aloof urgency. A light green chalk facet is a small clue from Julie, and the more you consider this idea, the more dissociative the body of Aigue Monème becomes.. As Aigue Monème softens and flows over skin, it is the perceptive transparency of its watery verdure that mesmerises, the crystallisation of Julie Baretta’s vision is serenely euphoric, both revelatory and veiled, exquisite and rewarding to wear.. Composition: . Light Green Chalk. Freshwater. earthy matter. Perfumer: Julie Barretta, 2023.

Eau de Parfum. This rose is on fire… Ensang Noir is an extraordinarily pungent rose perfume, sanguineous red petals stained with black ink, rusted at the bleeding edges. A scent of temptation, danger and the ritualistic fumes of burnt love. Fanatical, obsessive. Skin becomes an altar for this most plush and smoky offering.. Ensang Noir is the deep dark heart of Bertrand Duchaufour’s L’Entropiste collection. Blooded, cut hearts have long been familiar symbols of shattered love and love lost to bitter-sweet memory. It is the passion of Sailor and Lulu in Lynch’s Wild at Heart or Isabelle Adjani, cradling the head of her lover La Môle in La Reine Margot, her white gown and hands drenched in his blood. Enrobed in red.. The red rose in Ensang Noir proves again that there can never be enough rose perfumes in the world. The olfactive complexity of The Queen of Flowers offers up a multitude of possibilities. There is a dense mantling to the opening of the perfume, roses simmered in a robust red wine, the tannic bite of lees apparent in added cassis and coriander. Bertrand uses an unusual cucumber note to add a cleansing aqueous as the powerful aldehyde-dipped roses surge out of the heart with peony and creamy magnolia.. The base notes are magnificent, wreaths of incense and sweet opoponax resin combine with tar-edged birch and patchouli; everything swirling and dissipating in the ecclesiastical chambers of a mourning heart. Bertrand saves one more surprise for the final stages, a lick of darkening caramel that lacquers and mulls the scented endgame of Ensang Noir. He is often referred to as the Master of Incense and this beautiful perfume is a statement of his distinguished skill and imagination in the creation of atmospheric antechambers of scented mystery.. Eau de Parfum. A bewitching, idiosyncratic perfume, a portrait of marble white tulips and sap green stems, a sculpture of bending blooms in a vintage glass vase, impurities refracting and distorting the squeaking stalks and leaves. In general, tulips have no actual scent of their own, although there are certain varieties bred for scent. But they have an innate presence and personality. They are beautiful sculptural things; the multifarious cups and petals balanced on the rasp and snap of jadeite stems.. Tulips raise their chalices upright when first plunged into water but then they dance and writhe, twisting and bowing in the light, never really settling into repose. Semence Douce smells of all this and asks us to ponder the cycle of life from birth to death. Tulips can be dramatic, operatic in decline even, heads weighing heavy, weary petals falling or drying like paper, still and transparent.. The mix of sap-moist rice and creamy almond milk in Semence Douce suggests the lacteous stickiness of broken tulip stems and saffron lends a delicate pollen-coloured hue to the white petals. The mulchy squeak of hyacinths and amandine talc of heliotrope further enhance the abstract conjuring of the perfumer’s art in this alluring portrait of candescent tulips. A remarkable and haunting achievement. Composition: . Aldehyde, Anise, Saffron. Almond milk, Almond blossom, Hyacinth. Coumarin, Heliotrope. Perfumer: Bertrand Duchaufour, 2025. inci list: alcohol denat., parfum (fragrance), aqua (water), limonene, linalool, ethylhexyl methoxycinnamate, ethylhexyl salicylate, butyl methoxydibenzoylmethane, citral, eugenol .

Eau de Parfum. A scent of crisp Rajasthani mornings, the famous Indian Blue City waking from deep night to tangy market fruits, glorious tuberose weather and milky spices simmered and swirled in Masala Chai tea.. Jodhpur 6am is a sublime take on the chai trope, something that pops up from time to time in perfumery but rarely as elegantly or poised as this. A full-bodied black tea is satisfyingly blended with a piquant citrus burst of ginger and the green oiliness of cardamom, one of the most aromatic and distinctive spices in the perfumer’s palette.. The hot milk accord is another use of lacteous whiteness that is a feature of this L’Entropiste collection. It feels like perfumer Betrand Duchaufour is painting his compositions onto bone white canvases. Something of that whiteness will always show through like a phantom.. Jodhpur 6am combines its creamy spiced masala with a beautiful flourish of tuberose, a flower that radiates a voluptuous richesse, blessed with animalic indoles and solar beauty. There is a unique cut fruit vibe to the odour of blooming tuberose, a mix of yuzu and green mango. This marries perfectly with the pink zestiness of the ginger rhizome, providing a delicious counterpoint to the main masala melange. The atmospheric quality of the tea note makes Jodhpur 6am a delight to overdose on, revelling in the comfort of its gourmandise.. Composition: . Apricot, Cardamom, Ginger. Masala Chai, Black Tea, Milk, Tuberose. Savoury Notes, Spicy Notes. Perfumer: Bertrand Duchaofour, 2025. inci list: alcohol denat., parfum (fragrance), aqua (water), linalool, hydroxycitronellal, limonene, eugenol, cinnamal, ethylhexyl methoxycinnamate, citral, ethylhexyl salicylate, butyl methoxydibenzoylmethane, geraniol, benzyl benzoate, alpha-isomethyl ionone, farnesol, citronellol .

Eau de Parfum. The doomed beauty of Dorian Grey, Baudelaire’s poems, profane and sacred, and the eternal melancholy of immortality. All this and the ancient Greek belief in the spleen being the body’s repository for melancholia have been splendidly and sensually blended into the miasma of L’Entropiste’s Dorian’s Spleen. Bertrand has created a rich nocturnal gourmand that swirls with satiated desires and abandonment.. It is a dark, warm thing, tactile and thickly addictive, peaty whisky, and caramelised coffee forged in ash and darkness mixed with bitter chocolate and pimento. This Aztec echo is tempered by a fragrant leathered vanilla, sweet and boozy that billows through the composition with wistful sensuality. The presence of ash and smoke are vital in Dorian’s Spleen, suggesting late night drinking dens and woozy rendezvous, time lost to sybaritic pursuits and painted wicked with forbidden pleasures.. Dorian’s Spleen is a profoundly handsome scent, one thrumming and smeared with ambiguity and the many phantoms of pleasure we seek to leave behind but whose presence is a splenetic reminder we are the sum of elegiac multitudes.. Composition: . Caramel, Spices. Dark Chocolate, Whiskey. Smoke, Ash Tree, Coffee. Perfumer: Bertrand Duchaufour, 2025.

Eau de Parfum. This is a magnetic, icy void of a perfume, as if the crystalline edges of a black hole are pulling us into a metallic, glorious unknown. Some perfumes feel intimate and closed, others vast and ambiguous. Dawn Whispers is the latter, a call to memory through the frozen veil that hangs between our world and a glacial Elysium. The opening of cold white dust and milky metallics is detonated by macrocyclic musks with hints of wintry pear and smoky freezer burn.. A carbonic snow accord and bright ozonics expand the polar mood, increasing the moreish tenacity of Dawn Whispers. On skin the coldness feels like walking into a snowstorm, a taste of aluminium in the mouth, crushing white flowers that spill marble-coloured sap like wax onto the snow. Abstraction is oh so tricky to pull off without appearing pretentious, but this is Bertrand Duchaufour, the antithesis of tricksy. With Dawn Whispers we get to experience the intimate calving of the ice sheet, reminding us that love falls away and we either feel reduced or celebrate the ablation as a burden lifted.. Composition: . Ozonic Notes. Milk, Musk. Amber, Metallic Notes, Woods. Perfumer: Bertrand Duchaufour, 2025. inci list: alcohol denat., parfum (fragrance), aqua (water), geraniol, ethylhexyl methoxycinnamate, ethylhexyl salicylate, butyl methoxydibenzoylmethane, citral, linalool, citronellol, limonene . .

Eau de Parfum. Sada is the Japanese word for purity or chasteness, and Blanc Sada from L’Entropiste uses an achingly beautiful palette of achromatic notes to create a delicate homage to the mysterious geisha. Now more tourist curiosity than the provocative ciphers of an older, more tradition-bound Japan. This is reflected in a ghostly perfume that decorates the skin like fine alabaster powder. The elegant simplicity of sliding shoji is suggested and inherent with that, the diffusive light created by the traditional screens.. Blanc Sada is a fragile study of purity in white, of the traditional geisha, and oshiro, the mix of pale white rice powder and water applied over an oil-based foundation called Bintsuke-abura. This whiteness, contrasted with the elaborate black hair styles and blood-red doll lips was designed to make the ornately painted skin seem more ethereal in pre-electricity candle and lantern light as geishas performed their rigidly controlled roles. The alabaster skin was symbolic of unattainable beauty, human dolls that shimmered in the night.. A hint of juicy lychee brightens the rice top notes with sparkling aldehydes, settling into a sly straw tatami accord, aloof iris and a gasp of delicious white musks in the base. Everything about Blanc Sada is about skin, the nature of its properties, in shadow or illuminated in close rooms. The fragile grace of its snowy milk musks make it at once sensual and ephemeral, a memory of a memory.. Composition: . Milk. Rice Powder, Tatami, Iris. Straw. Perfumer: Bertrand Duchaufour, 2025. inci list: alcohol denat., parfum (fragrance), aqua (water), coumarin, linalool, citronellol, geraniol, ethylhexyl methoxycinnamate, limonene, ethylhexyl salicylate, butyl methoxydibenzoylmethane, citral, farnesol, cinnamal .

Eau de Parfum. Altamura is a beautifully strange experience, perhaps the most enigmatic of the L’Entropiste collection, a nebulous dance of perfumed particles, a cosmic aperitif of vaporous orange spirit and cold smoke.. Frankincense trails a fermented scent of ripening pineapple and shimmering pink pepper into the ether, scenting a void of emotional drifting memories. Sweet orange, reminiscent of Cointreau, the orange triple-sec liqueur, is offset by the distillation of various bitter peels, and it is the concept of this contrast that echoes through Altamura.. Perfumers have always been intrigued by the idea of how space and the cosmos might smell. Burnt metal from space debris, star-death, sulphur, cold rocks, ice, plastic and phantom whiffs of fuel. With Altamura, Bertrand Duchaufour presents his thoughts on this cosmic conundrum, with a perfume that swirls, rises and falls like remembrance.. The base notes as always with Bertrand are not just foundation or endgame but an arrangement of notes designed to support and ascend through the composition adding volatile transparent flesh to starlit bones. Fir balsam and pine provide an unexpected terpenic resolution, bathed in amber and the delicious remnants of sweet orange fade. Altamura rewards the skin and senses with a delicious haze of notes and each time it is worn it seems to reveal more of its ambiguous secrets.. . Composition: . Orange, Cointreau. Frankincense. Amber. Perfumer: Bertrand Duchaufour, 2025. . inci list: alcohol denat., parfum (fragrance), aqua (water), limonene, eugenol, linalool, ethylhexyl methoxycinnamate, cinnamyl alcohol, ethylhexyl salicylate, butyl methoxydibenzoylmethane, geraniol, citral, citronellol, ci 14700 (fd&c red 4), ci 42090 (fd&c blue1) .

Eau de Parfum. . A tribute to perfumer Odette Fontaine's grand-mère who called her Lapinou (bunny) and spending time baking in her kitchen in France together.. Cups of steaming hot black tea, coconut sablé cookies cooling on the marble countertop, bowl of lemon candies and heaps of knitting yarn and velvet ribbon trimmed dresses.. . Composition: . Pastilles Citron, Thé Noir. Dried Iris, Noix de Coco Sablés, Velvet Ribbon. Ambered Vetiver, Musk, Santal, Knit Cashmere. Perfumer: Odette Fontaine, 2025.

Extrait de Parfum. . Philtre D’Ambre is the latest perfume from Artimique, a Venetian-based, Venice-inspired perfume house founded by Sara Marzocchini, who was raised in and still lives in the legendary city of lagoons and canals. She has worked with celebrated perfumer Cristiano Canali to interpret her memories, waterscapes and artistic force that flows through Venice.. Philtre D’Ambre is perhaps the best perfume of her collection to date, a true love letter to Venice and the sea. The city is quite unique in its architecture and melting pot legacy as an important gateway into Europe for luxury and exotic goods. Allied to the Silk Road and other trade routes, the city witnessed the import and fervent trade of porcelain, silks, damask, spices, precious metals, books, tea, paper and other items from places like Japan, China, Korean and Central Asia.. The city was an independent state for a long period, governed by a Doge, whose court was awash in opulence. Music, art, glass, lace, fine jewellery, painting, religion and ship building flourished due to the economic boom afforded by trade and commerce.. Sara is influenced by all aspects of Venice, the buildings built on wooden pilings sunk into the mud, palazzos, masonry, the myriad waterways, sandbanks, food and religion. This is most evident in this lavish and all-consuming perfume, Philtre D’Ambre, translating loosely as amber love potion.. Despite the obvious beauty and grandeur of Venice, there has always been a melancholy haunted aspect to the city. The wintry exile of Lord Marchmain and his mistress Cara in Brideshead Revisited, the epistolary shenanigans in James’ The Aspern Papers and the disturbing psychosexual claustrophobia of The Comfort of Strangers, a 1990 film directed by Paul Shrader, based on the book by Ian McEwan.. It is however the 1973 Nicolas Roeg film Don’t Look Now, based on the 1971 short story by Daphne du Maurier that perhaps encapsulates the complex magnificence of Philtre D’Ambre. A disturbing study of grief, starring Donald Sutherland and the unbearably beautiful Julie Christie visiting Venice after the tragic accidental drowning of their young daughter in a pond.. He is restoring an old church and a chance meeting with a pair of eerie sisters, one of whom is milky-eyed blind and claiming psychic abilities, says that their daughter is trying to contact them. Venice is mournful and sparse in the film, the couple’s grief amplified by the city’s labyrinthine construction and air of endangered history. The city is slowly drowning, water wanting to claim the city as water claimed their red-coated daughter. There are flashes of red, balloons, coats, strangers vanishing around corners and of course the terrifying confrontation and the end.. Cristiano Canali has used a huge dose of red mandarin and plush crimson Turkish rose at the top of Philtre D’Ambre. It feels shocking, almost confrontational. This floats on an extraordinary Venice Lagoon accord, created by Canali for Philtre d'Ambre to counterpoint any overt prettiness. It’s saline and oceanic, restless and ripe, with a faint green murmur at the edges, like water against stone, suggesting Venice’s strange splendour, half-romance and half-ruin, in the heat of summer.. More often than not, perfumes that include aquatic concepts fall short, over reliant on ozonic effects and blunt saltiness. But here, Canali's lagoon accord and use of red algae are not a genre exercise. Instead, they tint everything in the composition, lending a brine-kissed, savoury patina to the rose, resins and spice in this lavish and pensive perfume.. Base notes of patchouli, benzoin resin and the leathered rub of labdanum are supported beautifully by Peru balsam and a Venetian Church accord, another one of Cristiano’s intelligent and atmospheric scene-setters. He suggests the damp, crumbling chalkiness of the churches mingled with the ghosts of Catholic Mass and snuffed out candles.. Philtre D’Ambre is a perfume of occurrence, phantoms and history, examining past and present in a powerful essay of city shadows, remembrance and Venetian culture and literary influence. A beautiful addition to an already singular brand, it smells glorious on skin, shapeshifting, emotional and affecting.. . Composition: . Red Mandarin, Turkish Rose, Venice Lagoon Accord. Myrrh, Red Algae Jungle Essence, Nutmeg, Clove. Patchouli, Benzoin Jungle Essence, Labdanum, Peru Balsam, Venetian Churches Accord. Perfumer: Cristiano Canali, 2025. . inci list: alcohol denat., parfum (fragrance), aqua (water), tetramethyl acetyloctahydronaphthalenes, pogostemon cablin oil, limonene, vanillin, citrus aurantium bergamia peel oil, benzyl benzoate, linalool, pinenes, linalyl acetate, citrus limon peel oil, myroxylon pereira balsam extract, rosa flower oil/extract, beta-caryophyllene, citronellol, benzyl cinnamate, geraniol, coumarin, citral, terpineol, terpinolene, geranyl acetate, benzyl alcohol, alpha-terpinene, carvone, eugenol, rose ketones, farnesol, camphor .

Extrait de Parfum. “Losing my sense of smell terrified me, threatening my livelihood and what brought me so much pleasure. When I regained my strength and nose, I went to my perfume studio to work on a commissioned fragrance. Bay of Bengal saltwater accord, dirtied drop by drop with the murky notes of patchouli, seaweed absolute, and red Buddha wood, reminiscent of river pollution, pyre ashes, aquatic funk. Mitti attar accord sourced from Kannauj, remnants of worship flowers, carnation, rose, and marigold, bright and spicy florals punctuated by cardamom and the nutmeg at its heart. Perfume would be my pilgrimage.” . —from In Sensorium: Notes For My People by Tanaïs . Pilgrimage is one of the most evocative perfumes in the Studio Tanaïs collection, an expansive, compelling portrait of the sacred Ganges, the transboundary river rising in the Himalayas and emptying into the Bay of Bengal. Named for Ganga, goddess of purification and forgiveness, the Ganges is worshipped as a living entity, the most sacred water in Hinduism. Thousands of people seek to bathe and offer tributes, cleanse the body of sin and feel reborn. Lanterns are floated, flowers scattered, little candle rafts carrying hopes and prayers onto the river.. Conjured into existence during the height of Covid, Pilgrimage speaks of yearning, a desire to flee enforced isolation and seek out a more profound sense of self. There are scented glimpses of abandoned ruins eaten by jungle, hot rain, worn mossy stones and glossy foliage dripping with downpour.. Saltwater, mitti attar and seaweed absolute conjure the Ganges with shadowy patchouli notes that hint at darkness below the surface. The bitter aromatics of juniper leaf, nutmeg, cardamom and saffron open Pilgrimage, hinting at heritage and trade, then a generous offering of flowers: roses, marigolds and carnations, garlanded as tributes.. Perfume as human and holy ablution. An unsettling pyre ash note rises mournfully in the final stages of Pilgrimage, anchoring the scent and serving to remind us that mortality is fleeting and we all return to the eternal cycle of life.. . Composition: . Nutmeg, Saffron, Juniper Leaf. Genda Attar (Marigold), Gulab Attar (Rose), Carnation, Cardamom. Mysore Sandalwood, Dark Patchouli, Seaweed Absolute, Buddha Wood, Mitti Attar, Saltwater Accord, Pyre Ash. . inci list: Organic Cane Alcohol, isopropyl myristate, essential oils, resins, absolutes, fine fragrance raw materials .

Extrait de Parfum. Sándalo is an olfactive study of tremulous earth, our smallness in the face of nature's elemental power. Tanaïs has forged a deeply strange and mesmerising perfume inspired by the pungent metallic violence and ashen eeriness of imagined volcanic activity on the Hawaiian islands, a chain of tropical land birthed from seething seas.. A volcanic ash accord plumes amid the imagined textural scent of lapilli, the small pumice stones ejected during eruptions. As the name suggests, it is Tanaïs' handling of generous doses of sandalwood that shapes Sándalo, in particular the deeply aromatic Hawaiian sandalwood bolstered by a Mysore sandalwood accord. The dry pencil shavings woodiness of cedar is subtle but gently burnished to allow a woody lullaby to form in the base notes.. Volcanic eruptions and lava flows consume everything in their path. Forests burn, sap and foliage, bark and trunks emitting singed air, green, sooty with rage. This is hinted at in Sándalo, the devouring of wood as ocean winds pull fire in differing directions. Intriguingly there is an initial scent of bursting rubicund berries that works elegantly with the milky sandalwood and piquant silver cedar.. Sándalo is disruptive, a perfume where skin is ocean and notes hit flesh, alive and seething with coastal beauty. Geographical happening as personal weather, a loaded glimpse into tumult and aftermath.. . Composition: . Cardamom, Volcano Ash Accord, Lapili. From Hawaii To Mysore Sandalwood Accord, Silver Cedar. . inci list: Organic Cane Alcohol, isopropyl myristate, essential oils, resins, absolutes, fine fragrance raw materials, benzyl benzoate, benzyl salicylate, citral, eugenol, farnesol, geraniol, isoeugenol, limonene, linalool .

Extrait de Parfum. "Lotus-water lily soliflore, water florals blooming out of a pond, out of our pits and stink, sandalwood and mitti attar from the Ganges river, salted by the Bay of Bengal at its mouths.” . —Tanaïs, “Soliflore,” In Sensorium: Notes For My People . The arresting odour of mitti attar, petrichor personified, features again in Studio Tanaïs' Nymphea. Mitti attar is created in hydro-distillation stills by mixing dry clay into a base of sandalwood oil, producing the magical, intensely aromatic scent of monsoon rain falling on parched earth. A Tanaïs signature note, it winds through the compositions like a monsoon serpent. The concept of rain-triggered, clay-tinted odour is deeply ingrained in our memory, a scent we seem to instinctively understand on a primal level.. Nymphea is a surreal, almost alien floral, a sacred raft of odours offering prayers and thanks, lit by candles, channelling heartfelt centuries of ritual. At its heart are three sacred lotuses: blue lotus, with an aquatic and grassy scent profile bright with hints of unripe melon and guava; white lotus, gentler, more aerated and gauzier; and pink lotus wax, more pollen-dusted and waxen. The delicate floral facets develop slowly with just the right amount of transparent vegetal muskiness.. The monsoon vibe of mitti attar hits parched ground as the heart of Nymphea blooms with the vastness of river water, tidal flats and silt. Bangladeshi sandalwood and sea salt complete the tidal meeting of fresh and sea water where the Ganges reaches the Bay of Bengal. The sacred lotuses are gently washed out into a waiting ocean, carrying dreams, prayers and celebrations. The silent flowers adrift on water spin gently, water lapping at petals. All this has been conjured by Tanaïs, making Nymphea fascinating to experience on skin.. . Composition . Sacred Blue Lotus, White Lotus, Pink Lotus Wax. Mitti Attar, Sea Salt, River Silt, Bandarban Sandalwood. . Organic Cane Alcohol, isopropyl myristate, essential oils, resins, absolutes, fine fragrance raw materials .
