Eau de Parfum. . Patchouli Noisette is the latest addition to Les Indémodables, an exquisitely calibrated marriage of patchouli from Sumatra and hazelnut from Piedmont.. Patchouli is a powerful material that has an earthy sexuality to it, oily musks and dirt sweetened by an underpinning of rubbed foliage and snapped stems. The piquant ecclesiastical vibe is often the facet that so many people are drawn to. It has a great affinity with roses, oudh, cocoa and indolic florals.. Distilled from the dry leaves and twigs of a shrub, patchouli was popularised by the exiled Spanish Princess Eugenie in London and Queen Victoria. The reason for this was that patchouli leaves were layered between Paisley shawls and fabric to repel moths. The cloth would arrive impregnated with patchouli and Royal approval created a Victorian viral desire for the scent.. Despite its muskiness and smokegreen depth, patchouli can be surprisingly comforting and Patchouli Noisette is no exception. There is an erotic pungency as the Grand Cru patchouli sets fire to skin, but perfumer Antoine Lie uses crushed and floury hazelnuts to offset the fumy chthonic force of the patchouli. The final stages of the dry down are just lovely; a soft gianduja note of flour, dark chocolate, and crushed hazelnuts.. Patchouli Noisette is a gorgeously wearable perfume that fills and lifts the senses, a piquant and supercharged addition to the excellent Les Indémodables line.. .

Cologne Absolute. . Escale en Haiti is a rich, sparking hymn to vetiver, one of the most beloved ingredients in perfumery. In many ways it is a family of fragrances in its own, such is its popularity and addictive permutations of scent. Like grape varieties, tea, iris rhizomes and vanilla, the concept of terroir has become important, with country of origin, soil and weather conditions and local agricultural practices playing a vital part in shaping the odour of the ingredients.. Escale en Haiti is a beautiful scent, crystalline like a dream sea. Pink pepper and juniper berries add a cocktail vibe. The cold earthiness of the vetiver has unusual support. Atnoine Lie, the perfumer has wrapped the vivid grassiness with vanillic tonka bean and a smudged and smoky myrrh from Somalia. The overall impression is potentially jarring, but a warm sense of powdered almonds and an echo of crystallised violet make Escale en Haiti such a delight on the skin.. . Composition: . Special Grand Cru Vetiver Oil 22%. 97% NATURAL. Background of this unique Vetiver Grand Cru Extract:. The best quality of vetiver oil in the world comes from les Cayes in Haiti. In line with Les Indémodables' high quality requirements, they developed a unique Grand Cru grade with their local partner..

Cologne Absolute. . Escale en Indonesie is a hymn to ambergris. Ejected into the sea and via extraordinary osmosis, the lumps of ambergris are soothed, blurred, and transfigured by the heat of sun, salt water and time into a ombre-grey substance of salted silk and wax, smoothed by sea and time. It is without parallel, adding beautiful oceanic notes with warm skies, fine sand, and corporeal allure. In Escale en Indonesie the amber floats on a citrus sea of bergamot, orange blossom and lush Sicilian lemons that seem made from the sun itself. The ivory green of pungent jasmine mixed with a creamy sandalwood provide a light but durable base for everything. It is a very addictive scent, kept in the fridge then spritzed on, momentarily chilling the air and senses.. . Composition: . 5% Grand Cru Ambergris Tincture. 99% NATURAL.

Extrait de Parfum. . Tambour Sacré (Sacred Drum), is soaked in mystery. Composition: . Bergamot, Orange, Cardamom, Black Pepper. Cinnamon, Acacia Farnesiana, Tuberose Absolute, Coffee Absolute CO2 Extract. Mysore Sandalwood, Somalian Myrrh, Opoponax, Benzoin, Tonka Bean. Perfumer: Cristiano Canali, 2018.

Extrait de Parfum. . Nuvolari is inspired by the legendary Italian racing driver Tazio Nuvolari, who won most of his races in Alfa Romeos.. The fuel accord is thrilling enough, but the motor racing accord in the heart, wrapped in grassy peppermint and neroli is an astonishing feat of fragrant creativity.. A petrolic rose rises through an overture of agitated Madagascan black pepper, lemon and that shimmering fuel accord that smells like smouldering rainbow toys.. Ostensibly Nuvolari smells like a Ballardian collision of cologne and meta-chypré, the wreckage spilled with the fuel of fallen men, but the metallised rubber and Bulgarian rose bloom magnificently to balance the speed and burn, like a vintage silk headscarf, caught on jagged metal then cast into clear blue sky.. . Composition: . Italian Lemon, Madagascan Black Pepper, Fuel Accord. Yakima Mint, Metallic Neroli, Bulgarian Rose, Motor Racing Accord. Haitian Vetiver Molecular Distillation, Laotian Oud, Ambroxan, Asphalt Accord. Perfumer: Cristiano Canali, 2021.

Eau de Parfum Intense. . Fundamental smells yeasty, fatty, dirty and gorgeously indulgent. Shifting from the bread and melon hit of white wine to a more lolling, post coital silence and flecks of falling make-up and smeared lipstick.. The central personality is the Garganega grape used predominantly in the production of Soave, imparting an odour of furred gooseberries, apricot compote, damp artesian wells and brioche. There is a whiff of noble rot, botrytis cinerea, the strange benevolent grey mould that adds an eccentric sweetness to certain wines.. Beeswax, leather and iris bolster the vintage mood, and yet the scent feels futuristic and compellingly glorious.. . Composition: . Bergamot, Mandarin, Soave Grape Accord. Italian Orris Butter, Clary Sage Absolute, Lavender Absolute, Beeswax Absolute, Labdanum. Leather Accord, Javanese Vetiver Molecular Distillation, Atlas Cedarwood, Cacao Absolute, Sandalwood. Perfumer: Cristiano Canali, 2015.

Eau de Parfum. . There is a miasma of vice that haunts the Marlou perfumes. Briac Frocrain, the owner and perfumer of Marlou wants us to consider the erotic fundamentals of skin; the exudation of our hides, nudging at hidden desires and our hankering for the forbidden and disapproved.. Marlou challenges the perceptions of our bodies as taboo concepts with its layered beatific musks, animalic whiffs of fur, horse and morning-after flesh.. Corpalium has an immediate whoosh of cigar debris, stained with a beautiful fenugreek note, hinting at sweaty role playing after hours in a room furnished in deepest umber-hued furniture, old wood, leather and the remnants of a dying fire. A feature note is iris but showcased as the freshly uprooted rhizome, mingled with the silver powered finish of the aged root. Ambrette further enhances the iris and the lingering tobacco of the start.. As it develops on skin, Corpalium becomes more abstract, an equine stable odour rises subtly enough to allow the scent of fodder and leaves to provide a deeply erotic ground for the preceding materials, notes and accords. There is more piquancy and aridity to Corpalium than the already existing Marlou perfumes, and once again we marvel at this remarkable invitation to musky danger.. . Composition: . . Iris, Ambrette, Fenugreek, Guaiac Wood, Cedar, Castoreum. . Perfumer: Briac Frocrain in collaboration with perfumer Stéphanie Bakouche, 2022. . inci list: Alcohol Denat, Parfum, Aqua, Benzyl Benzoate, Benzyl Cinnamate, Limonene, Coumarin, Farnesol, Benzyl Alcohol, Citronellol, Geraniol, Linalool, Eugenol, Isoeugenol .

Eau de Parfum. . Milky Dragon, draws inspiration from Milky Oolong tea, resulting in a multifaceted and captivating olfactory rendering. A delicate arrangement of bergamot, buchu and cardamom gradually gives way to velvety lactones and indulgent hazelnut.. A coloratura assembly of jasmine, rose and violet mingle, creating an ambrosial opacity delivered crystalline and silver-tongued. Cedar and fir balsam rubbed with a warm, comforting smudge of cashmeran leave an indelible impression, blurred and mysterious.. Milky Dragon is a cryptic composition, mystery and opacity behind porcelain cold thematics. Beneath the surface of this fascinating perfume, exquisite things writhe and scintillate like jade dragon scales.. . Composition: . Bergamot, Bucchu, Cardamom. Butter, Rose Ketones, Jasmine, Ionones, Lactones, Hazelnut, Ozonic Notes, Clary Sage Absolute. Cashmeran, Virginia Cedar, Fir Balsam, Oakmoss. . inci list: Alcohol Denat. (78% VOL.), Aqua (Water), Parfum (Fragrance), Tetramethyl acetyloctahydronaphthalenes, Citrus Aurantium Bergamia Peel Oil, Linalyl Acetate, Juniperus Virginiana Oil, Limonene, Linalool, Pinene, Beta- Caryophyllene, Rose Ketones, Citral, Pogostemon Cablin Leaf Oil, Acetyl Cedrene, Alpha-isomethyl ionone. .

listings.rawTitle: LE FLOCON DE JOHANN K Full Size 50ml | 1.7oz
listings.description: Eau de Parfum. What connects Johann Kepler, 17th century astronomer and mathematician with Lydie Lascarmontier, a French glaciologist who was trapped in ice for 56 days in 2011 on the Astrolabe Antarctica expedition?. The answer is Le Flocon de Johann K, (Johann K’s Snowflake) the first composition by French perfumer Isabelle Larignon.. Kepler wrote a treatise revealing the astonishing beauty of snowflakes, their hexagonal nature and the fact that every snowflake is unique.. In December 2018, while trying to decide between two ideas for a fragrance for her olfactory design course (teenage wallflower or snowflake), Isabelle heard a radio interview in December 2018 with the glaciologist Lydie Lascarmontier who was asked by a journalist if snow had a smell, which was left unanswered.. But the concept of snow having an odour set fire to Isabelle’s imagination, and her decision was made.. Le Flocon de Johann K is a perfume of tranquil observance, suggesting an enveloping sense of powder dusted over a gelid garden. Under the snow, a garden slumbers, mimosa is frozen, narcissus absolute sleepily exudes its narcotic soul, while clean menthol and ephemeral threads of incense plume in boreal air. Bergamot plays like sunlight on the upper reaches of this compelling scent.. Everything in Le Flocon de Johann K has been composed with snowy elegance. As to the scent of snow, this imaginative perfume glitters against an achromic ground dreamed into being by a talented perfumer.. Composition: . Bergamot, Lemon, Cyclamen. Cardamom, Frankincense, Mimosa Absolute, Aquatic Accord, Ozonic Accord, Mint. Oak Moss, White Musk, Narcissus Absolute. Perfumer: Isabelle Larignon, 2021. inci list: Alcohol Denat. (78% VOL.), Aqua (Water), Parfum (Fragrance), Limonene, Alpha Pinenes, Citrus Aurantium Bergamia Fruit Oil, Beta-Pinenes, Acetyl Cedrene, Beta-Caryophyllene, Linalool, L-Menthol, Citral, Narcissus Extract, Benzyl Benzoate, Anise Alcohol, Alpha-Terpineol, Linalyl Acetate, Farnesol. .

Eau de Parfum. . A dense, balsamic perfume ablaze with sacred resins, alpine woods and green vanilla, Oriental Velours is a slow, sensuous descent into shadows lit by firelight. It begins with a bracing sting of Alpine spruce, icy, aromatic, almost metallic, before succumbing to the warm flood of Somalian myrrh. Thick, honeyed and skin-bound, the myrrh creates a kind of sacred veil over the composition.. Through that veil slips jasmine, feral and intimate, its Grand Cru Indian alcoolat lending breath and bloom to the otherwise smouldering air. Beneath it all, Grand Cru Haitian vetiver thrums with earthen smoke, while green vanilla from Madagascar, herbaceous, molasses-rich, trickles through like a velveted thread.. A perfume of devotion, seduction, and fire-drenched stillness.. . Composition: . Alpine Spruce Oil. Grand Cru Indian Jasmine Alcoolat 5%. Somalian Myrrh Oil 15%, Grand Cru Madagascar Green Vanilla Oleoresin 2.5%, Grand Cru Haitian special Vetiver Oil 10%. . inci list: Alcohol Denat., Parfum, Water / Aqua, Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone, Benzyl Alcohol, Benzyl Benzoate, Benzyl Cinnamate, Benzyl Salicylate, Cinnamal, Cinnamyl Alcohol, Citral, Coumarin, Citronellol, Eugenol, Geraniol, Limonene, Linalool, BHT, Ethylhexyl Methoxycinnamate, Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane (Avobenzone) .

Eau de Parfum. . A refined floral leather perfume built around the apricot-skin sensuality of Chinese osmanthus. Cuir de Chine by Les Indémodables blends osmanthus alcoolat and absolute for a multifaceted scent—fruity, floral and delicately animalic.. Accents of Egyptian jasmine and clary sage bring subtle musk and softness, while tobacco and leather enrich the base with a warm, androgynous pull. This is an elegant yet quietly subversive fragrance: floral, leathery and seductive with an edge of danger.. . Composition: . Alpine Clary Sage Oil. Grand Cru Chinese Osmanthus Alcoolat 10%, Grand Cru Late Crop Egyptian Jasmine Absolute 1%, Chinese Osmanthus Absolute 1%. Turkish Mild Tobacco Absolute .2%. Perfumer: Florence Fouillet Dubois, 2016. . inci list: Alcohol Denat., Parfum, Water / Aqua, Benzyl Alcohol, Benzyl Benzoate, Citral, Coumarin, Eugenol, Geraniol, Limonene, Linalool, BHT, Ethylhexyl Methoxycinnamate, Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane (Avobenzone) .

Eau de Parfum. . A slow-burning flame and an embrace, Vanille Havane ignites the senses with decadent intensity, blending green vanilla and Colombian cocoa over a supple base of suede and amber.. This fiercely sensual perfume opens with the smoky warmth of tobacco and a whisper of volcanic fire. Jasmine absolute unfurls with animalic allure, softened by the caramelised sweetness of burnt sugar. As the scent deepens, a rich, plummy cocoa accord rises, enveloping the skin in textured, indulgent layers.. Crafted with bold precision and unapologetic elegance, Vanille Havane is not just a vanilla fragrance. It’s desire made tangible, clinging to the skin like an insatiable lover.. . Composition: . Grand Cru Vanilla ‘Mauvais’ Comoros Infusion 9.1%. Grand Cru Egyptian Jasmine Egypt concrete ‘Distillat’ .2%. Grand Cru Colombian Cocoa Ultrasound Extraction 3.1%. Perfumer: Antoine Lie: 2020. . inci list: Alcohol Denat., Parfum, Water / Aqua, Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone, Benzyl Benzoate, Cinnamal, Coumarin, Limonene, Eugenol, Geraniol, Linalool, BHT, Ethylhexyl Methoxycinnamate, Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane (Avobenzone) .

Eau de Parfum. . A slow-burning flame and an embrace, Vanille Havane ignites the senses with decadent intensity, blending green vanilla and Colombian cocoa over a supple base of suede and amber.. This fiercely sensual perfume opens with the smoky warmth of tobacco and a whisper of volcanic fire. Jasmine absolute unfurls with animalic allure, softened by the caramelised sweetness of burnt sugar. As the scent deepens, a rich, plummy cocoa accord rises, enveloping the skin in textured, indulgent layers.. Crafted with bold precision and unapologetic elegance, Vanille Havane is not just a vanilla fragrance. It’s desire made tangible, clinging to the skin like an insatiable lover.. . Composition: . Grand Cru Vanilla ‘Mauvais’ Comoros Infusion 9.1%. Grand Cru Egyptian Jasmine Egypt concrete ‘Distillat’ .2%. Grand Cru Colombian Cocoa Ultrasound Extraction 3.1%. Perfumer: Antoine Lie: 2020. . inci list: Alcohol Denat., Parfum, Water / Aqua, Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone, Benzyl Benzoate, Cinnamal, Coumarin, Limonene, Eugenol, Geraniol, Linalool, BHT, Ethylhexyl Methoxycinnamate, Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane (Avobenzone) .

Eau de Parfum. A lush Moroccan rose perfume with green spice, cedarwood warmth and cooling mint.. Rose de Jamal is a vivid study in contrast: the deep, jammy richness of Moroccan rose absolute unfolds against crushed green leaves, spicy pink pepper and the shimmering cool of Nanah mint.. Underneath, Atlas cedarwood adds creamy, woodsy depth with its soft animalic hum anchoring the brightness above. This rose fragrance is verdant and red, dewy and earthen, blooming like a field of rubies under desert dawn.. A radiant, unexpected take on the Queen of Flowers that's wild, fresh and unapologetically sensual.. . Composition: . Madagascan Pink Pepper Co2 Extract 1.7%, French Lavender Essence .7%. Moroccan Rose Absolute 5.5%. Moroccan Atlas Cedar Essence 2.8%. Perfumer: Antoine Lie, 2019. . inci list: Alcohol Denat., Parfum, Water / Aqua, Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone, Citral, Coumarin, Citronellol, Limonene, Eugenol, Farnesol, Geraniol, Linalool, BHT, Ethylhexyl Methoxycinnamate, Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane (Avobenzone) .

Eau de Parfum. . Musc des Sables is a radiant musk fragrance that evokes sun-warmed skin, whispering dunes and the quiet shimmer of twilight.. This soft and sensual perfume opens with milky white musks and a breeze of salt-kissed ambergris, evoking the hush of a desert evening. Fleeting citrus notes of mandarin flicker like embers, while smooth patchouli and dry woods ground the composition in warmth and depth.. A hint of iris absolute brings a powdery elegance, rising through the musky glow like stars through a violet dusk. Musc des Sables is a modern skin scent—clean, creamy, intimate and subtly addictive.. . Composition: . Italian Green Mandarin Essence 4.9%. French Orris Essence .3%. Indonesian Patchouli Essence 1.1%, Ambergris Tincture .7%. Perfumer: Antoine Lie, 2019. . inci list: Alcohol Denat., Parfum, Water / Aqua, Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone, Benzyl, Benzoate Cinnamal, Coumarin, Citronellol, Limonene, Geraniol, Linalool, BHT, Ethylhexyl Methoxycinnamate, Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane (Avobenzone) .

Eau de Parfum. Iris Perle captures the rare beauty of orris root, earthy, powdery and refined, layered with delicate mimosa, violet and bright citrus.. Beneath its airy elegance lies a skin-warm blend of ylang-ylang and sunlit sparkling musks, grounding the composition with subtle sensuality.. This radiant iris fragrance wears like bottled stardust: cool and celestial at first, then warm and intimate as it settles. A modern, mineral-rich take on iris, sophisticated, soft and unforgettable.. . Composition: . Alpine Clary Sage, Moroccan Mimosa Absolute .25%. Grand Cru French Orris Absolute .3%, Indian Jasmine Absolute .7%, Madagascan Ylang Ylang Oil VOP .7%. Perfumer: Antoine Lie, 2017. . inci list: Alcohol Denat., Parfum, Water / Aqua, Limonene, Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone, Benzyl Alcohol, Benzyl Benzoate, Benzyl Salicylate, Citral, Coumarin, Citronellol, Eugenol, Farnesol, Geraniol, Isoeugenol, Linalool, BHT, Ethylhexyl Methoxycinnamate, Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane (Avobenzone) .

Eau de Parfum. . A lush, green fougère perfume alive with heat, light and botanical intensity.. Fougère Émeraude opens with radiant tuberose, solar, creamy and lush, set against herbaceous lavender, powdery mimosa and roasted tonka bean. This unexpected floral heart adds warmth and complexity, while notes of almond, moss and soft woods evoke the dry, sunlit canopy of a Provençal forest in full bloom.. Infused with aromatic freshness and a touch of floral sensuality, this is a modern fougère and a contemporary reimagining of one of perfumery’s most iconic structures.. . Composition: . Alpine Clary Sage Oil, Grand Cru French Saint Cristol Lavender 3%. Grand Cru Moroccan Mimosa Absolute 1%, Indian Tuberose Alcoolat 15%. Venezuelan Tonka Beans Absolute 3%. Perfumer: Florence Fouillet Dubois, 2016. . inci list: Alcohol Denat., Parfum, Water / Aqua, Benzyl Benzoate, Benzyl Salicylate, Butylphenyl Methylpropional, Citral, Citronellol, Coumarin, Eugenol, Evernia Prunastri Extract, Farnesol, Geraniol, Isoeugenol, Limonene, Linalool, BHT, Ethylhexyl Methoxycinnamate, Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane (Avobenzone) .

Eau de Parfum. . Symphonic citrus notes in perfect harmony. Brisk, bitter-tangy bergamot, followed by a fragrant breath of sweet orange and blushy rose petals that intermingle with a suave, aromatic greenness.. Salty splashes of ambergris mixed with a discreet yet ever-present patchouli, on an elegantly tailored, tenacious mossy base. A twist of anisic tarragon and effervescent aldehydes create a subtle tension.. Chypre Azural is frost and effervescence made scent. A effortlessly chic love letter to the classic chypre structure.. . Composition: . Sicilian Tarocco Orange Oil 10%, Alpine Tarragon Oil. Grand Cru Egyptian Centrifolia Rose Absolute 1%. Ambergris Infusion 2%, Grand Cru Aceh Province Indonesian Patchouli oil 5%. Perfumer: Florence Fouillet Dubois, 2016. . inci list: Alcohol Denat., Parfum, Limonene, Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone, Benzyl Alcohol, Benzyl Salicylate, Citral, Citronellol, Eugenol, Farnesol, Geraniol, Linalool, Evernia Prunastri Extract, Butylphenyl Methylpropional, BHT, Ethylhexyl Methoxycinnamate, Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane (Avobenzone) .

Eau de Parfum. Salty brine on noon-kissed skin. Sweaty-sweet immortelle uplifted by soapy-bright aldehydes, emulating a sense of walking barefoot on lone sand dunes that dip into the sea.. Steely cardamom, dry-ambery puffs of clary sage crash against a tawny orange blossom just as patchouli takes lead and weaves together, with darkness and might, the brighter notes of neroli and heavier ones of jasmine absolute.. Natural ambergris whistles a song of salt and hoary grey winter close – Ambre Suprême a dive and a soar, above and deep down into the oceanic maze.. . Composition: . Aldehydes, Swiss Grand Cru Clary Sage Oil, Madagascan Pink Pepper CO2 Extract, Indian Cardamom Oil. Grand Cru Orange Flower Alcoolat, Moroccan Neroli Oil, Indian Jasmine Absolute, Grand Cru Ache Indonesian Patchouli Oil. 10% Ultrasound Extracted Grand Cru Ambergris Tincture, Ultrasound Extracted French Grand Cru Immortelle Extract France (grown on the private field of Atelier Français des Matières). Perfumer: Antoine Lie, 2021. . inci list: Alcohol Denat., Parfum, Water / Aqua, Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone, Benzyl Alcohol, Benzyl Benzoate, Benzyl Salicylate, Citral, Coumarin, Citronellol, D-Limonene, Eugenol, Geraniol, Isoeugenol, Linalool, Evernia Prunastri Extract, BHT, Ethylhexyl Methoxycinnamate, Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane (Avobenzone) .

Eau de Parfum. . Poudrextase trembles between intimations of post coital skin and Versailles pomades.. Powder is used a lot as a descriptor in perfumery, but here it has a different mood; one of sinister boudoir and dirty wonder. Harlots absterging with soapy flower waters and dusting with scented powders before another client demands their time.. Rose, rice powder, tonka, cypress and civet rupture through the formula in a provocatively lacteous and musky fashion.. . Composition: . Rice Powder, Rose, Cypress, Tonka Bean, Civet. Perfumer: Barbara Zoebelein, 2019. Artistic direction: Briac Frocrain. . inci list: Alcohol Denat, Parfum, Aqua, Limonene, Coumarin, Citronellol, Geraniol, Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone, Linalool, Cinnamal, Eugenol, Citral, Benzyl Benzoate, Benzyl Alcohol, Benzyl Salicylate, Isoeugenol, Farnesol .

Eau de Parfum. . Ambilux has beautiful movement on skin, the elegant disturbance of Anaïs Nin, warmed through by tender weather and memory skin of summer romances.. Ambilux fumes of hot innocence corrupted amid dunes of whispering sedge. Flushed skin and love-sweat dusted with salt, cumin and immortelle suggesting perspiration and rapture, faces buried in sea-damp hair.. Ylang-ylang is the white floral note that sings the flesh electric, calling for inhalation and words of want.. . Composition: . Pink Pepper, Cumin, Helichrysum, Ylang-ylang, Incense, Costus. Perfumer: Alexandra Monet. Artistic direction: Briac Frocrain. . inci list: Alcohol Denat, Parfum, Aqua, Bezyl Salicylate, Limonene, Linalool, Citronellol, Coumarin, Geraniol, Benzyl Benzoate, Farnesol, Citral, Isoeugenol, Eugenol, Benzyl Alcohol, Alpha-Isomethyl, Ionone, Cinnamyl Alcohol .

Eau de Parfum. . The etymology of carnal concerns carne, meat; literal fleshiness, an opportune interpretation in Carnicure and its sly feral discord hinting at skin transformed and ominous night manoeuvres.. A perfumed body that hints at skinwalking in amber, patchouli, violet, waxen musks and glittering fur. A crystalline elegance to Carnicure underpins the gaminess, a gorgeous mood of vintage stillness that endures on skin, trembling between sex and dreams of lost love.. . Composition: . Orange Blossom, Violet, Patchouli, Sandalwood, Labdanum, Musk, Civet. Perfumer: Tristan Rostain,2016. Artistic direction: Briac Frocrain. . inci list: Alcohol Denat., Parfum, Aqua, Benzyl Benzoate, Citronellol, Limonene, Alpha-Isomethyl, Ionone, Benzyl Cinnamate, Cinnamal, Geraniol, Coumarin, Benzyl Alcohol, Eugenol, Farnesol, Hydroxy-Citronellal, Citral, Linalool, Isoeugenol, Benzyl Salicylate, Cinnamyl Alcohol . .

Extrait de Parfum. . A blazing spark of clove and the disarming warmth of cinnamon join with the lusty-sweet scent of honeyed immortelle on a stark landscape of black Pepper and crackling vetiver.. Glacial cardamom, smoky cypriol and dark, angular incense wrapped in saffron-laced leather forge a bewitching tension.. Scorpio Rising takes you all the way to the edge and leaves you dangling, begging for salvation but praying for release.. ase.. Composition: . Pink Pepper, Black Pepper, Clove Bud, Cinnamon Absolute (all from La Réunion, Madagascar. Indian Cardamom, French Immortelle, Somalian Incense. Indian Cypriol, Atlas Cedarwood, Guaiac Wood, Saffron, Sandalwood, Ambroxan, Cashmeran, Haitian Vetiver, Leather. Scorpio Rising is an extrait at 25% concentration made with ingredients from L’Atelier Français des Matières. . Perfumer: Antoine Lie, 2022. . inci list: Alcohol Denat., Fragrance (Parfum), Water (Aqua/Eau), BHT, Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane, Ethyl-Hexyl Methoxycinnamate, Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone, Cinnamal, Eugenol, Geraniol, Limonene, Linalool .

Eau de Parfum. . A sultry, anthranilic Indian tuberose doused in an overdose of bittersweet tonka bean effloresces under a spotlight of tangy bergamot.. Aromatic jets of cardamom prolong the opening freshness into a suede accord polished by the glossy sweetness of Laotian cinnamon while discreet filaments of birch tar ink their smokiness into the purring base of patchouli.. An indolent and sensuous grand floral-leather, Night Flower is the addictive scent of nights one never wants to forget.. . Composition: . Italian Bergamot, Birch Tar, Guatemalan Cardamom. Suede, Indian Tuberose, Laotian Cinnamon. Indonesian Patchouli, Venezuelan Tonka Bean, Musk. Perfumer: Antoine Lie, 2016. . inci list: Alcohol Denat., Fragrance (Parfum), Water (Aqua/Eau), Geraniol, Coumarin, Limonene, Citral, Benzyl Benzoate, Cinnamal, Eugenol, Hydroxycitronellal, Benzyl Alcohol, Citronellol .

Extrait de Parfum. . Power. Temptation. Provocation. Subjugation. Overdosed rarities, an epitome of sumptuosity, an archetype of sexuality made sublime using a decadent cocoa Co2 extract, green vanilla oleoresin and a jaw-dropping ultrasonic tincture of veritable ambergris.. Outwardly virile in its outburst of mace and blue ginger yet lewdly feminine with its yawning afterglow of benzoin and hyraceum, putting cedarwood and sandalwood side-by-side fluid vis-à-vis.. Mxxx. does not seek to push forward the limits of gender. Mxxx. shatters them completely.. . Composition: . Madagascan Blue Ginger, Mace, Saffron, Ethiopian Olibanum, Pink Peppercorn. Ultrasound Extracted Trinidad Cacao, Virginia Cedarwood, Sandalwood. Haitian Vetiver, Indonesian Patchouli, Laotian Benzoin, Castoreum, 7% Natural Ambergris, Pierre d'Afrique (Hyraceum), Ultrasound Extracted Madagascan Green Vanilla. Please Note: No animals were harmed in collecting the rare animal derived, naturally expelled ingredients in Mxxx., and as always, ERIS PARFUMS never tests its fragrances on animals . Both the Ambergris and Pierre d’Afrique in Mxxx. were provided by Stéphane Piquart of Behave , an organisation founded on principles of transparent and sustainable sourcing, fair trade, and the empowerment of local populations.. . Perfumer: Antoine Lie. . inci list: Alcohol Denat., Fragrance (Parfum), Water (Aqua/Eau), BHT, Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane, Ethyl-Hexyl Methoxycinnamate, Benzyl Salicylate, Citral, Citronellol, Coumarin, Evernia Prunastri Extract, Geraniol, Limonene, Linalool .

Eau de Parfum. . An image of androgynous corporeity, a bed of milky sandalwood whence vanillic musks overflow.. Outcrops of crimson spices; a languorous kiss of saffron bolstered by a boisterous ginger over a solid backdrop where a suave cocoa clashes with the raunchy din of a castoreum blackened by smoky strokes of birch tar and vetiver.. A bestial and consensual addiction spiked with frankincense and light, Mx. deftly configures a space where all genders exist as one.. . Composition: . Indian Ginger, Madagascar Black Pepper, Saffron, Ethiopian Olibanum. Australian Sandalwood, Virginian Cedarwood. Haitian Vetiver, Indonesian Patchouli, Laotian Benzoin, Birch Tar, Venezuelan Cacao, Castoreum. Perfumer: Antoine Lie, 2017. . inci list: Alcohol Denat., Fragrance (Parfum), Water (Aqua/Eau), Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane, Ethyl-Hexyl Methoxycinnamate, Ethylhexyl Salicylate, Limonene, Linalool, Coumarin, Citronellol, Citral, Geraniol, Evernia Prunastri Extract .

Eau de Parfum. . A mirage of neroli speckled with soapy aldehydes yields to the indolic blows of an Egyptian jasmine and its incomparably violent beauty.. A stroboscopic duet of nutmeg and cypriol follows, punctuating an unstoppable march towards a supreme animalic accord unleashing the most perverse inflections of perfumery.. Moans and bite marks, warmth of styrax, chypré spectre of patchouli and the mingled scent of fur and skin, Ma Bête summons all that human psyche forever keeps unconfessed.. . Composition: . Aldehydes, Tunisian Neroli, Indian Nutmeg. Indian Cypriol, Honduran Styrax, Indian Jasmine Sambac. Virginia Cedarwood, Indonesian Patchouli, Synthetic Animalic Accord. Perfumer: Antoine Lie. . inci list: Alcohol Denat., Fragrance (Parfum), Water (Aqua/Eau), Linalool, Citronellol, Limonene, Hydroxycitronellal, Coumarin, Benzyl Salicylate, Amyl Cinnamal, Eugenol, Geraniol, Benzyl Benzoate, Citral, Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone, Isoeugenol, Cinnamyl Alcohol, Benzyl Alcohol, Benzyl Cinnamate, Cinnamal .

Eau de Parfum. . A bitter zest of mandarin opens an ode to nature’s awakening. Earthy-shrill galbanum morphs into a strident greenness carried by blackcurrant absolute and the aquatic facets of violet leaf.. Under the cooling shade of fig leaves, narcissus unveils its merciless allure in garments of leather, honey, and hay, leaving only the spinescent green of tomato leaf smoothened by a lick of ambroxan.. Rustling blades of grass swaying from dark to watery greens, Green Spell delivers an impressionistic rite of spring.. . Composition: . Italian Mandarin, French Blackcurrant Bud Absolute, Iranian Galbanum. Egyptian Violet Leaf Absolute, French Narcissus Absolute, Tomato Leaf, Fig Leaf. Haitian Vetiver, Ambroxan, Musk. Perfumer: Antoine Lie, 2021. . inci list: Alcohol Denat., Fragrance (Parfum), Water (Aqua/Eau), Citronellol, Limonene, Linalool .

Eau de Parfum. . Dunes. Sand. Gold. The overpowering brightness of coriander. The dryly marine seaweed absolute. Lush flowers, an oasis of treacly-fawn orange blossom and ingenuous jasmine.. Noonlight's parching spices, pimento berry and pink pepper redden and shiver. Sundown is come; the densely fruity labdanum summoned, to rise until the bright and milky Atlas cedarwood is spent.. Wafts of day and dark, Belle de Jour is a solar haze scintillating with incandescent drops of moonlight.. . Belle de Jour is a 2017 Art & Olfaction Awards Finalist.. . Composition: . Moroccan Coriander, Madagascan Pink Pepper, Tunisian Orange Flower. Spanish Cistus Labdanum, Egyptian Jasmine, Indian Pimento Berry. Atlas Cedarwood, Musk, Seaweed Absolute.
